
# MASTER PROMPT — INOVEXA ERP
## Complete Tunisian SaaS ERP — Full Audit, Development, Repair & Business Transformation

Act as a Senior Full-Stack Architect, SaaS Product Engineer, ERP Specialist, UI/UX Designer, Cybersecurity Engineer and DevOps Specialist.

Your mission is to transform my existing project into a professional, complete, scalable and commercial Tunisian ERP SaaS platform.

### 2. GENERAL OBJECTIVE

Develop Inovexa ERP into a complete Tunisian ERP SaaS solution for businesses and SMEs.

The platform must provide:
- Independent customer registration.
- Individual customer accounts.
- Google authentication and email authentication.
- Three-day free trial.
- Automatic account suspension after trial expiration.
- Subscription and payment management.
- Sector-specific product and pricing suggestions.
- Complete administrator dashboard.
- Customer analytics and business analytics.
- Professional public website.
- Complete ERP modules.
- French and Arabic support, including RTL.
- Tunisian currency (TND).
- Configurable Tunisian tax and invoice settings.

Preserve the existing visual identity, branding, logo and useful functionality.

### 3. CUSTOMER REGISTRATION AND AUTHENTICATION

Each company/customer must be able to create its own account independently.

Implement:

**Registration**
- Full name.
- Company name.
- Email address.
- Phone number.
- Password.
- Business sector.
- Optional company information.

**Authentication**
- Sign in with Google OAuth.
- Sign up with Google.
- Sign up using email and password.
- Login using email and password.
- Email verification.
- Forgot password.
- Password reset.
- Secure session management.
- Logout.

Each customer must have their own account and organization.

Never use a shared customer account.

Implement proper multi-tenant architecture:
- Every company has its own organization.
- Each organization's data must remain isolated.
- One company must never access another company's information.
- Enforce tenant isolation in backend APIs, not only in the frontend.
- Apply secure authorization and role-based permissions.

Google OAuth must use official OAuth configuration. Do not invent credentials. Document the required Google Cloud configuration and redirect URLs.

### 4. FREE TRIAL — 3 DAYS

Implement an automatic three-day free trial for every newly registered company.

Business rules:

1. Trial begins when the company successfully completes registration.
2. Trial duration is exactly 72 hours.
3. Display remaining trial time in the customer dashboard.
4. Show the trial expiration date.
5. Send email notifications before expiration.
6. At expiration, automatically suspend access to paid ERP functionality.
7. Display a professional subscription-expired page.
8. Allow the customer to view subscription details and payment instructions.
9. Allow the customer to contact the administrator.
10. Restore access after successful payment or authorized admin activation.

Account states:
- TRIAL
- ACTIVE
- EXPIRED
- SUSPENDED
- CANCELLED

Important:
- Trial expiration must be calculated and validated on the backend.
- Do not depend on the customer's browser clock.
- Do not delete customer data after trial expiration.
- Preserve all company data during suspension.
- Allow the administrator to reactivate accounts.
- Prevent customers from bypassing trial restrictions by changing browser data.

### 5. SUBSCRIPTION AND BILLING

Build a complete subscription management system.

Include:
- Subscription plans.
- Monthly and annual billing options.
- Number of users.
- Selected ERP modules.
- Subscription start and end dates.
- Payment status.
- Invoice history.
- Payment history.
- Renewal management.
- Trial conversion.
- Suspended subscriptions.
- Manual payment validation by administrator.

Use TND as the default currency.

Payment integration:
First inspect available payment infrastructure and Tunisian payment requirements. Support a configurable payment provider architecture.

Do not invent payment API credentials or claim that a payment provider is integrated without implementing and testing it.

Allow an administrator to validate payments manually when online payment is not configured.

Create a professional sector-based system.

Supported sectors:

- Suggested products.
- Suggested selling prices.
- Suggested purchase prices when appropriate.
- Suggested profit margins.
- Suggested service fees.
- Relevant ERP modules.
- Business-specific recommendations.

**Restaurants**

Important pricing rules:
- Build an editable recommendation engine.
- Suggestions must be configurable by the administrator.

- Distinguish purchase cost, selling price, profit margin, service fees and taxes.
- Never present estimated prices as official market prices.
- Do not invent market research or claim that suggestions are verified market prices.
- Allow each company to customize its own prices.
- Support TND and configurable tax rates.

### 16. DEVELOPMENT METHOD — STRICT RULES

Do not attempt to rebuild the entire application from scratch.

Follow these stages:

**Stage 1 — Full audit**
Inspect the complete repository and identify existing functionality, missing functionality, bugs and architectural limitations.

**Stage 2 — Architecture**
Propose the architecture for:
- Multi-tenancy.
- Authentication.
- Trial management.
- Subscriptions.
- Billing.
- Sector recommendations.
- Admin analytics.

**Stage 3 — Database and backend**
Implement necessary models, APIs, validations and database migrations.

Preserve existing data and provide a backup and rollback strategy before schema changes.

**Stage 4 — Frontend**
Implement public pages, authentication, customer experience and administrator dashboard.

**Stage 5 — Integration**
Connect all pages to real backend APIs and database data.

**Stage 6 — Testing**
Test registration, Google login, email login, trial expiration, suspension, payment validation, tenant isolation and administrator permissions.

**Stage 7 — Deployment**
Prepare a complete and tested Namecheap deployment package.

# Inovexa ERP

ERP de gestion pour PME tunisiennes : ventes et achats (devis → bon de livraison → facture → avoir), stock multi-dépôts,
règlements, comptabilité, paie, CRM, caisse, rapports — avec un assistant IA branché sur les données de l'entreprise.

```
backend/    API NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL
frontend/   Interface Next.js
docs/       Guides (voir ci-dessous)
mobile/     Application mobile
```

## Démarrage rapide

**Avec Docker** (PostgreSQL + API + interface) :

```bash
cp .env.example .env          # renseignez POSTGRES_PASSWORD et JWT_SECRET (openssl rand -base64 48)
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec -e ADMIN_EMAIL=vous@exemple.tn -e ADMIN_PASSWORD='un mot de passe long' backend node dist/cli/create-admin.js
```

**En développement** (PostgreSQL local requis) :

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/inovexa_erp JWT_SECRET=dev-secret
npm run start:dev              # le schéma suit les entités automatiquement (synchronize)
ADMIN_EMAIL=vous@exemple.tn ADMIN_PASSWORD='un mot de passe long' npm run admin:create

cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm run dev
```

API : <http://localhost:3001> — documentation interactive : <http://localhost:3001/api/docs> (désactivée en production, `ENABLE_SWAGGER=true` pour l'activer).

## Qualité

| Commande (dans `backend/`)  | Rôle                                                                 |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run typecheck`         | vérification TypeScript                                              |
| `npm test`                  | tests unitaires (calculs de TVA/retenue/timbre, paie, chiffres en lettres…) |
| `npm run test:e2e`          | tests de bout en bout sur PostgreSQL réel, schéma créé par les migrations (`E2E_ADMIN_URL` requis) |
| `npm run migration:generate -- Nom` | génère la migration d'une évolution d'entité                 |

import { APP_GUARD } from '@nestjs/core';

import { assertUniqueEntityTables } from './common/assert-unique-entities';

// Échoue tout de suite, avec un message clair, si deux entités visent la même table

import { LogisticsModule } from './modules/logistics/logistics.module';
import { TransporteurModule } from './modules/transporteur/transporteur.module';

import { ObjectivesModule } from './modules/objectives/objectives.module';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TypeOrmModule.forRootAsync({
      useFactory: async () => {
        // En développement (synchronize) : convertit sur place les colonnes dont le type diffère de l'entité
        // (évite le « drop + recréation » de TypeORM). En production, ce sont les migrations qui font foi.
        if (isSynchronizeEnabled()) await runPreSyncFixes(process.env.DATABASE_URL);
        return buildTypeOrmOptions();
      },
    }),
    // Limite de débit : par personne connectée (sinon par IP). Protège l'API contre les abus.
    ThrottlerModule.forRoot([
      {
        name: 'default',
        ttl: 60_000,
        limit: (ctx: any) => (ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest()?.user ? 900 : 120),
      },
    ]),
    AuditModule,
    MailModule,
    CompanyModule,
    StockModule,
    FinanceModule,
    ProductionModule,

    DocumentsModule,

    TransporteursModule,
    IaModule,
    UploadModule,
    DepartmentsModule,
    ProjectsModule,
  ],
  controllers: [AppController],
  providers: [
    AppService,
    // Ordre important : d'abord l'authentification + droits, ensuite la limitation de débit (qui a besoin de savoir QUI appelle).
    { provide: APP_GUARD, useClass: AccessGuard },
    { provide: APP_GUARD, useClass: UserThrottlerGuard },
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}

import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { NestExpressApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { join } from 'path';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
import { ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  json,
  urlencoded,
  type NextFunction,
  type Request,
  type Response,
} from 'express';
import compression = require('compression');
import helmet from 'helmet';
import { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from '@nestjs/swagger';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule);

  // Derrière un reverse-proxy (Render, Railway, Vercel…) : l'adresse IP réelle vient de X-Forwarded-For.
  app.set('trust proxy', 1);

  // Express 5 lit les paramètres d'URL en mode « simple » : on garde le mode « extended » d'Express 4
  // (ex. ?filtre[statut]=payee → { filtre: { statut: 'payee' } } et ?ids[]=1&ids[]=2 → { ids: ['1', '2'] }).
  app.set('query parser', 'extended');

  // 🛡️ En-têtes de sécurité (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options…).
  // Les images /uploads sont affichées par le site (autre origine) : d'où cross-origin.
  const swaggerEnabled = process.env.ENABLE_SWAGGER === 'true' || process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
  app.use(
    helmet({
      crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: 'cross-origin' },
      contentSecurityPolicy: swaggerEnabled ? false : undefined,
    }),
  );

  // ⚡ Compression gzip des réponses (listes JSON de ventes, produits, clients…) :
  // 5 à 10 fois moins de données à transférer vers le navigateur.
  // Les flux SSE (text/event-stream) ne sont pas compressés pour rester en temps réel.
  app.use(
    compression({
      threshold: 1024,
      filter: (req, res) => {
        const type = String(res.getHeader('Content-Type') || '');
        if (type.includes('text/event-stream')) return false;
        return compression.filter(req, res);
      },
    }),
  );

  // ✅ زيادة حجم الطلب المسموح به (افتراضياً 100kb فقط)
  app.use(json({ limit: '50mb' }));
  app.use(urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '50mb' }));

  // Express 5 laisse req.body à undefined quand la requête n'a pas de corps (Express 4 donnait {}) :
  // on garde l'ancien comportement pour les contrôleurs qui lisent body.xxx sans vérification.
  app.use((req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (req.body === undefined) req.body = {};
    next();
  });

  const allowedOrigins = [
    process.env.FRONTEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3000',
    'http://localhost:3000',
    ...(process.env.FRONTEND_URLS || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
  ];
  app.enableCors({
    origin: allowedOrigins,
    methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
    credentials: true,
    // ⚡ Le navigateur garde la réponse de pré-vérification CORS (OPTIONS) pendant 2 h :
    // chaque appel avec en-tête Authorization ne fait plus qu'UN aller-retour au lieu de deux.
    maxAge: 7200,
  });

  // Les DTO à décorateurs sont validés ; les corps typés `any` (anciens modules) passent tels quels.
  app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ transform: true }));

  app.useStaticAssets(join(process.cwd(), 'uploads'), {
    prefix: '/uploads/',
  });

  // 📘 Documentation interactive de l'API (OpenAPI / Swagger) : /api/docs
  if (swaggerEnabled) {
    const config = new DocumentBuilder()
      .setTitle('Inovexa ERP — API')
      .setDescription('API REST de l’ERP : ventes, achats, stock multi-dépôts, documents commerciaux, comptabilité, paie… Authentifiez-vous avec POST /auth/login puis « Authorize » avec le jeton.')
      .setVersion('2.0')
      .addBearerAuth()
      .build();
    SwaggerModule.setup('api/docs', app, SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config), { swaggerOptions: { persistAuthorization: true } });
  }

  const port = process.env.PORT || 3001;
  await app.listen(port);
  console.log(`🚀 Server running on port ${port}`);
}
bootstrap();

/** 8 caractères minimum, au moins une lettre et un chiffre. */
export function assertStrongPassword(password: string) {
  if (typeof password !== 'string' || password.length < 8 || password.length > 128 || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(password) || !/\d/.test(password)) {
    throw new BadRequestException('Mot de passe trop faible : 8 caractères minimum, avec au moins une lettre et un chiffre.');
  }
}

export class AdminService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    private dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  async getAllClients() {
    return this.userRepository.find({
      where: { role: 'client' },
      select: ['id', 'email', 'name', 'companyName', 'phone', 'subscriptionStart', 'subscriptionEnd', 'isActive', 'createdAt', 'modules']
    });
  }

  async getClientById(id: number) {
    const client = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id, role: 'client' },
      select: ['id', 'email', 'name', 'companyName', 'phone', 'subscriptionStart', 'subscriptionEnd', 'isActive', 'createdAt', 'modules']
    });
    if (!client) throw new NotFoundException('Client non trouvé');
    return client;
  }

  async getClientModules(id: number) {
    const client = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id, role: 'client' },
      select: ['id', 'modules']
    });
    if (!client) throw new NotFoundException('Client non trouvé');
    return client.modules || {};
  }

  async updateClientModules(id: number, modules: Record<string, boolean>) {
    const client = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id, role: 'client' } });
    if (!client) throw new NotFoundException('Client non trouvé');
    
    client.modules = modules;
    await this.userRepository.save(client);
    
    return { 
      success: true, 
      message: 'Modules mis à jour avec succès',
      modules: client.modules
    };

import { join } from 'path';
import { DataSourceOptions } from 'typeorm';

/**
 * Configuration unique de la base, partagée par l'application (AppModule) et la ligne de commande (migrations).
 *
 * Mode du schéma :
 *  - DÉVELOPPEMENT (par défaut hors production) : `synchronize` — le schéma suit les entités automatiquement ;
 *  - PRODUCTION (NODE_ENV=production) : migrations versionnées exécutées au démarrage. Un changement d'entité
 *    ne peut plus supprimer de colonne par accident : il faut écrire (ou générer) une migration.
 *
 * Variables d'environnement :
 *  - DATABASE_URL        (obligatoire)
 *  - DB_SYNCHRONIZE      "true" | "false" : force le mode (sinon : true hors production, false en production)
 *  - DB_MIGRATIONS_RUN   "false" pour ne PAS lancer les migrations au démarrage (par défaut : oui quand synchronize = false)
 *  - DB_SSL              "true" pour activer SSL (hébergeurs qui l'exigent)
 */
export function isSynchronizeEnabled(): boolean {
  const forced = process.env.DB_SYNCHRONIZE;
  if (forced === 'true') return true;
  if (forced === 'false') return false;
  return process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
}

export function buildTypeOrmOptions(overrides: Partial<DataSourceOptions> = {}): DataSourceOptions {
  const synchronize = isSynchronizeEnabled();
  return {
    type: 'postgres',
    url: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    ssl: process.env.DB_SSL === 'true' ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : false,
    entities: [join(__dirname, '..', '**', '*.entity{.ts,.js}')],
    migrations: [join(__dirname, 'migrations', '*{.ts,.js}')],
    migrationsTableName: 'schema_migrations',
    synchronize,
    migrationsRun: !synchronize && process.env.DB_MIGRATIONS_RUN !== 'false',
    logging: false,
    ...overrides,
  } as DataSourceOptions;
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const IS_DEV = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';

const API_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'https://inovexa-erp-4.onrender.com';

function apiOrigins(): { origin: string; ws: string } {
  try {
    const u = new URL(API_URL);

    let ws: string;

    if (u.protocol === 'https:') {
      ws = 'wss://' + u.host;
    } else {
      ws = 'ws://' + u.host;
    }

    return {
      origin: u.protocol + '//' + u.host,
      ws,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      origin: 'http://localhost:3001',
      ws: 'ws://localhost:3001',
    };
  }
}

// Next.js 16 : l'ancien middleware.ts s'appelle désormais proxy.ts (exécuté par Node.js).
export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const nonce = Buffer.from(
    crypto.randomUUID()
  ).toString('base64');

  const {
    origin: API_ORIGIN,
    ws: API_WS,
  } = apiOrigins();

  const ALLOW_EVAL =
    process.env.CSP_ALLOW_EVAL === '1';

  let scriptSrc: string[];

  if (IS_DEV) {
    scriptSrc = [
      "'self'",
      "'unsafe-inline'",
      "'unsafe-eval'",
    ];
  } else {
    scriptSrc = [
      "'self'",
      "'nonce-" + nonce + "'",
      "'strict-dynamic'",
    ];

    if (ALLOW_EVAL) {
      scriptSrc.push("'unsafe-eval'");
    }
  }

  const directives: Record<string, string[]> = {
    'default-src': ["'self'"],

    'script-src': scriptSrc,

    'style-src': [
      "'self'",
      "'unsafe-inline'",
    ],

    'img-src': [
      "'self'",
      'data:',
      'blob:',
      'https://flagcdn.com',
      // Photos des produits de démonstration (liens Unsplash, voir backend/src/modules/admin/demo-product-images.ts)
      'https://images.unsplash.com',
      API_ORIGIN,
    ],

    'font-src': [
      "'self'",
      'data:',
    ],

    'connect-src': [
      "'self'",
      'data:',
      'blob:',
      API_ORIGIN,
      API_WS,
    ],

    'media-src': ["'self'"],

    'object-src': ["'none'"],

    'frame-src': ["'self'"],

    'frame-ancestors': ["'self'"],

    'worker-src': [
      "'self'",
      'blob:',
    ],

    'base-uri': ["'self'"],

    'form-action': ["'self'"],

    // Relevé des violations (fichier + ligne responsables) : voir app/api/csp-report/route.ts
    'report-uri': ['/api/csp-report'],
  };

  if (IS_DEV) {
    directives['connect-src'].push('ws:');
  } else {
    directives['upgrade-insecure-requests'] = [];
  }

  const csp = Object.entries(directives)
    .map(([key, values]) => {
      if (values.length > 0) {
        return key + ' ' + values.join(' ');
      }

      return key;
    })
    .join('; ');

  const requestHeaders = new Headers(
    request.headers
  );

  requestHeaders.set(
    'x-nonce',
    nonce
  );

  requestHeaders.set(
    'Content-Security-Policy',
    csp
  );

  const response = NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: requestHeaders,
    },
  });

  response.headers.set(
    'Content-Security-Policy',
    csp
  );

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    {
      source:
        '/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|ico|txt|xml)$).*)',

      missing: [
        {
          type: 'header',
          key: 'next-router-prefetch',
        },
        {
          type: 'header',
          key: 'purpose',
          value: 'prefetch',
        },
      ],
    },
  ],
};--- next.config.js
'use strict';

const IS_DEV = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
const IS_PROD = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

const API_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'https://inovexa-erp-4.onrender.com';

const API_HOST = (() => {
  try {
    return new URL(API_URL).host;
  } catch {
    return 'localhost:3001';
  }
})();

const API_PROTOCOL = (() => {
  try {
    return new URL(API_URL).protocol;
  } catch {
    return 'http:';
  }
})();

const SECURITY_HEADERS = [
  {
    key: 'X-DNS-Prefetch-Control',
    value: 'on',
  },
  {
    key: 'X-Content-Type-Options',
    value: 'nosniff',
  },
  {
    key: 'X-Frame-Options',
    value: 'SAMEORIGIN',
  },
  {
    key: 'X-XSS-Protection',
    value: '1; mode=block',
  },
  {
    key: 'Referrer-Policy',
    value: 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
  },
  {
    key: 'Permissions-Policy',
    // microphone=(self) : la recherche vocale du tableau de bord utilise le micro (demande d'autorisation au clic).
    value: 'camera=(), microphone=(self), geolocation=(), interest-cohort=()',
  },
  ...(IS_PROD
    ? [
        {
          key: 'Strict-Transport-Security',
          value: 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload',
        },
      ]
    : []),
];

const nextConfig = {
  reactStrictMode: true,
  compress: true,
  output: 'standalone',
  // Le dépôt contient aussi un package-lock.json à la racine : on fixe la racine sur ce dossier
  // (comportement de Next 14) au lieu de laisser Next.js 16 la deviner.
  outputFileTracingRoot: __dirname,
  generateEtags: true,
  poweredByHeader: false,

  experimental: {
    // Les pages sont dynamiques (nonce CSP) mais leurs données sont chargées dans le navigateur :
    // la structure d'une page déjà visitée peut être réutilisée 3 min sans repasser par le serveur
    // (retour sur une page = instantané). Valeur par défaut de Next 14 : 30 s.
    staleTimes: {
      dynamic: 180,
      static: 300,
    },
  },
  staticPageGenerationTimeout: 120,
  pageExtensions: ['tsx', 'ts', 'jsx', 'js'],

  env: {
    NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: API_URL,
    NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME: 'Inovexa ERP',
    NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION: '2.0.0',
    NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_DESCRIPTION: 'Solution ERP nouvelle génération',
  },

  images: {
    formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'],
    deviceSizes: [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920],
    imageSizes: [16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 384],
    minimumCacheTTL: IS_PROD ? 3600 : 60,
    dangerouslyAllowSVG: true,

    remotePatterns: [
      {
        protocol: API_PROTOCOL.replace(':', ''),
        hostname: API_HOST.split(':')[0],
      },
      {
        protocol: 'http',
        hostname: 'localhost',
        port: '3000',
      },
      {
        protocol: 'https',
        hostname: 'flagcdn.com',
      },
    ],
  },

  webpack(config, { isServer, dev }) {
    config.module.exprContextCritical = false;

    config.devtool = dev
      ? 'cheap-module-source-map'
      : false;

    if (!isServer) {
      config.resolve.fallback = {
        fs: false,
        net: false,
        tls: false,
        path: false,
        os: false,
        crypto: false,
      };
    }

    if (!dev && !isServer) {
      config.optimization = {
        ...config.optimization,
        moduleIds: 'deterministic',
        chunkIds: 'deterministic',
      };
    }

    return config;
  },

  async headers() {
    return [
      {
        source: '/:path*',
        headers: SECURITY_HEADERS,
      },
      // /_next/static : Next.js envoie déjà « public, max-age=31536000, immutable » en production.
      // Next.js 16 déconseille de redéfinir cet en-tête (il perturbe le mode développement).
      {
        source: '/api/:path*',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value: 'no-store, max-age=0',
          },
        ],
      },
      // Images et traductions de /public : gardées en cache par le navigateur au lieu d'être
      // revalidées à chaque visite (le logo apparaît sur toutes les pages).
      {
        source: '/images/:path*',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value: 'public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        source: '/logo.png',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value: 'public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        source: '/locales/:path*',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value: 'public, max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400',
          },
        ],
      },
    ];
  },

  async redirects() {
    return [];
  },
};

module.exports = nextConfig;--- env.local keys

--- ci
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop, 'claude/**']
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  backend:
    name: API (compilation, tests unitaires, tests de bout en bout)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres" --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: backend/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - name: xmllint (validation XSD des factures électroniques TEIF)
        run: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq libxml2-utils
      - name: Vérification des types
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Tests unitaires
        run: npm test
      - name: Compilation
        run: npm run build
      - name: Tests de bout en bout (PostgreSQL réel, schéma créé par les migrations)
        env:
          E2E_ADMIN_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
        run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Les entités et les migrations sont synchronisées
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/schema_check
        run: |
          PGPASSWORD=postgres psql -h localhost -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE schema_check'
          npm run migration:run
          npm run migration:generate -- CiCheck | tee /tmp/migration-check.log
          grep -q "déjà à jour" /tmp/migration-check.log || { echo "::error::Une entité a changé sans migration : lancez « npm run migration:generate -- NomDeLaMigration » et commitez le fichier."; exit 1; }

  frontend:
    name: Interface (types, compilation)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

Agent:Backend tenant isolation audit
IN
READ-ONLY security audit. Do NOT modify, create or delete any file, do not run git commands that change state, do not start servers. Only read code and report.

Repository: c:\inovexa-erp — a NestJS 11 + TypeORM + PostgreSQL backend in `backend/src` (about 18k lines, ~45 modules under `backend/src/modules`). It is a multi-tenant SaaS ERP.

What I already know (do not re-derive):
- Tenancy model: table `users`. A company owner has role `client`; team members have `ownerId` pointing at the owner. `JwtStrategy.validate` (backend/src/modules/auth/jwt.strategy.ts) returns `req.user = { userId: <OWNER id = tenant id>, actorId: <real person>, role, isTeamMember, permissions }`. Every tenant-owned table is expected to have a `userId` column and every query is expected to filter on `req.user.userId`.
- A global `AccessGuard` (backend/src/modules/auth/access.guard.ts) only authenticates when an Authorization header is present and applies role permissions for team members; it does NOT reject anonymous requests. A route is only protected if its controller/handler has `@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)`.
- Platform admin = role `admin`; admin controller checks `req.user.role !== 'admin'` inline.
- Known issue already found: `UsersService.updateProfile` does `Object.assign(user, body)` with an untyped body (mass assignment → a client can set `role`, `modules`, `subscriptionEnd`, `ownerId`...). Look for the same pattern elsewhere.

Your job: go through EVERY controller and service under backend/src/modules (and backend/src/common/audit, backend/src/app.controller.ts) and report concrete, verified findings in these categories. Read the actual code of each one; do not guess from file names.

1. UNAUTHENTICATED ROUTES: any controller or handler with no `@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)` (class-level or method-level). For each: file:line, HTTP method + path, and what it exposes. Say explicitly which are intentionally public (login etc.).
2. CROSS-TENANT ACCESS (IDOR): any service method that reads/updates/deletes a row by `id` (or other identifier) without also constraining on the tenant `userId` (e.g. `findOne({ where: { id } })`, `update(id, ...)`, `delete(id)`, raw SQL without `"userId" = $n`, query builders missing the userId where). Also list endpoints that accept a `userId`/`clientId`/`ownerId` from the request body/query/params and trust it. For each: file:line, the method, the route that reaches it, and a one-line exploit description.
3. MASS ASSIGNMENT: `Object.assign(entity, body)`, `repo.save({...body})`, `repo.update(id, body)`, `repo.create(body)` where body is unvalidated and the entity has sensitive columns (`userId`, `role`, `ownerId`, `isActive`, `modules`, subscription fields, prices computed server-side...). file:line + which sensitive field can be overwritten.
4. ADMIN-ONLY routes: list every route gated on role admin, how the check is done, and whether a non-admin gets a real 403 or a 200 with `{error: ...}`. Flag any admin-level action reachable by a normal `client`.
5. MODULES NOT REGISTERED / DEAD CODE: modules that exist on disk but are not imported in backend/src/app.module.ts (e.g. check `client-modules`, `inventory/*`, `purchasing/*`, `finance/*` sub-folders, `production/*` sub-folders, `companies`, `ia` vs `ai`, `analytics`, `customers`, `search`, `export`), duplicate entities/tables, placeholder services that return hard-coded/fake data. For each say: registered or not, real or stub.
6. Entities WITHOUT a `userId` (tenant) column: list every `*.entity.ts` with its table name and whether it has `userId`; for those without, say how tenant scoping is (or is not) achieved (e.g. via parent document).
7. Other notable security problems you actually see in code (file upload validation in modules/upload, the AI modules sending data to third parties, secrets or default credentials in code, SQL built by string concatenation with user input, JWT default secret fallback, etc.).

Output format: a structured report in English with the seven numbered sections; each finding as a bullet with `path:line`, severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), and one or two sentences. End with a table "module → auth guard? → tenant filter on every query? → notes" covering every registered module. Be precise and complete rather than brief; I will fix what you report, so false positives cost me time — only report what you verified by reading the code, and mark anything uncertain as "unverified".

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests de bout en bout sur une VRAIE base PostgreSQL, schéma créé uniquement par les migrations (comme en production).
#
#   E2E_ADMIN_URL=postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/postgres npm run test:e2e
#
# Chaque suite (*.e2e.js) s'exécute sur une base neuve : la base d'essai est supprimée puis recréée avant chacune.
# Variables : E2E_ADMIN_URL (obligatoire, base « postgres » d'un compte pouvant créer des bases),
#             E2E_DB_NAME (défaut erp_e2e), E2E_PORT (défaut 4101).
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
: "${E2E_ADMIN_URL:?Définissez E2E_ADMIN_URL (ex. postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres)}"
DB="${E2E_DB_NAME:-erp_e2e}"
PORT="${E2E_PORT:-4101}"
BASE_URL="${E2E_ADMIN_URL%/*}"
export DATABASE_URL="$BASE_URL/$DB" NODE_ENV=production JWT_SECRET="e2e-secret" PORT="$PORT" BASE="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
LOG="$(mktemp)"
PID=""
cleanup() { [ -n "$PID" ] && kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null; psql "$E2E_ADMIN_URL" -q -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS \"$DB\" WITH (FORCE)" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
trap cleanup EXIT

[ -f dist/main.js ] || npm run build >/dev/null || { echo "Échec de la compilation"; exit 1; }

failed=0
for suite in test/e2e/*.e2e.js; do
  echo; echo "══ $(basename "$suite") ══"
  [ -n "$PID" ] && { kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null; PID=""; }
  psql "$E2E_ADMIN_URL" -q -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS \"$DB\" WITH (FORCE)" -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$DB\"" >/dev/null || exit 1
  node dist/main.js >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
    sleep 1
    grep -q "Server running" "$LOG" && break
    kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || { echo "Le serveur s'est arrêté :"; tail -20 "$LOG"; exit 1; }
  done
  grep -q "Server running" "$LOG" || { echo "Démarrage trop long :"; tail -20 "$LOG"; exit 1; }
  node test/e2e/seed.js || exit 1
  node "$suite" || failed=1
done
exit $failed
const BASE = process.env.BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:4101';
let token = null, failures = 0, passes = 0;
async function api(method, path, body, raw) {
  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, { method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) }, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  if (raw) return res;
  const text = await res.text(); let json; try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  return { status: res.status, body: json };
}
function check(name, cond, extra) { if (cond) { passes++; console.log('  ok  ', name); } else { failures++; console.log('  FAIL', name, extra !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(extra).slice(0, 400) : ''); } }
const setToken = (t) => (token = t);
const summary = () => { console.log(`\n${passes} ok, ${failures} échec(s)`); process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0); };
module.exports = { api, check, setToken, summary };
...

# Exploitation : déploiement, migrations, sauvegardes, secrets

## 1. Déploiement avec Docker

```bash
cp .env.example .env              # renseigner POSTGRES_PASSWORD et JWT_SECRET
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec -e ADMIN_EMAIL=vous@exemple.tn -e ADMIN_PASSWORD='un mot de passe long' backend node dist/cli/create-admin.js
```

- En production (`NODE_ENV=production`) l'API **applique les migrations au démarrage** : le schéma est créé ou mis à jour tout seul,
  sans `synchronize`. Une entité modifiée sans migration ne touche donc jamais aux données de production.
- Pour lancer les migrations à la main (`DB_MIGRATIONS_RUN=false`) : `npm run migration:run:prod`.
- Le conteneur API expose un contrôle de santé (`GET /`). Placez un reverse proxy HTTPS (Caddy, Nginx, Traefik) devant l'API et l'interface.
- Pensez à fixer le **même fuseau horaire** pour Node et PostgreSQL (UTC recommandé : `TZ=UTC`, `timezone = 'UTC'`) ; les colonnes
  `timestamp` sont lues avec le fuseau du processus Node.

## 2. Faire évoluer le schéma (développeurs)

1. Modifier l'entité.
2. `npm run migration:generate -- NomDeLaMigration` (avec `DATABASE_URL` pointant sur une base déjà migrée) : le SQL produit est **idempotent**.
3. Relire le fichier ; si TypeORM propose « DROP COLUMN puis ADD COLUMN » pour un changement de type, le remplacer par `ALTER COLUMN … TYPE … USING …` (sinon les données sont perdues — le script le signale).
4. Commiter l'entité **et** la migration. La CI échoue si une entité diffère des migrations.

## 3. Sauvegardes

Tout est dans `backend/scripts/ops/`.

| Action                         | Commande                                                          |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Sauvegarde chiffrée            | `DATABASE_URL=… BACKUP_PASSPHRASE=… npm run backup`               |
| Copie hors serveur             | ajouter `BACKUP_S3_URI=s3://bucket/inovexa` (+ `BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT` hors AWS) |
| **Test de restauration**       | `ADMIN_DATABASE_URL=…/postgres DATABASE_URL=… BACKUP_PASSPHRASE=… npm run restore:check` |
| Restauration réelle            | `TARGET_DATABASE_URL=…/base_vide BACKUP_PASSPHRASE=… bash scripts/ops/restore.sh fichier.dump.gpg` |

- Le workflow `.github/workflows/backup.yml` sauvegarde chaque nuit puis **restaure la sauvegarde dans une base temporaire et la compare à
  la source**. Secrets à créer : `DATABASE_URL`, `BACKUP_PASSPHRASE`, et idéalement `BACKUP_S3_URI` + clés d'accès.
- **Conservez la phrase de passe en dehors du serveur** (gestionnaire de mots de passe) : sans elle, les sauvegardes sont illisibles.
- La restauration refuse une base cible non vide et vérifie la somme de contrôle : on ne peut pas écraser une base par erreur.
- Objectif raisonnable : sauvegarde quotidienne, conservation 14 jours en local + 30 jours hors serveur, test de restauration à chaque sauvegarde.

## 4. Secrets : à faire tout de suite

Deux fichiers contenant des secrets ont été versionnés dans l'historique Git avant ce nettoyage (`.env.local` et `backend/admin-register.json`).
Ils sont maintenant ignorés et retirés de la version courante, **mais restent lisibles dans l'historique** :

1. Changer le `JWT_SECRET` (cela déconnecte tout le monde) et tous les mots de passe contenus dans ces fichiers (base de données, SMTP, comptes administrateurs).
2. Si le dépôt est ou a été public, considérer ces valeurs comme compromises même après nettoyage de l'historique
   (`git filter-repo --path .env.local --path backend/admin-register.json --invert-paths`, puis push forcé et reclonage par tous).
3. Aucun mot de passe par défaut n'est fourni : `docker-compose.yml` refuse de démarrer sans `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` et `JWT_SECRET`.

## 5. Variables d'environnement

Voir `.env.example`, qui liste chaque variable avec son effet. Obligatoires : `DATABASE_URL` (ou `POSTGRES_*` avec Docker Compose) et `JWT_SECRET`.
Deux audits tournent en arrière-plan (isolation des données côté API, écrans et appels côté interface). Pendant ce temps je lis le site public, la connexion et le menu des modules.

OUT
// lib/site/content.ts
// Contenu des pages publiques (produits, tarifs, à propos, contact, blog, mentions légales).
// Les fichiers de content/site sont générés à partir de l'export docs/contenu-site (site inovexa-erp.com).
// Module serveur uniquement (pas de "use client").
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { LANG_COOKIE, lookup, pickLanguage } from "@/lib/i18n";
import en from "@/content/site/i18n/en.json";
import fr from "@/content/site/i18n/fr.json";
import es from "@/content/site/i18n/es.json";
import postsIndex from "@/content/site/posts/index.json";

export type SiteLang = "en" | "fr" | "es";
export const SITE_LANGS: SiteLang[] = ["en", "fr", "es"];
export type PageName = "products" | "pricing" | "about" | "contact" | "privacy" | "terms";

/** Texte en ligne : chaîne, ou nœud (b, i, s, code, a, img, br). */
export type Inline = string | { t: string; c?: Inline[]; href?: string; src?: string; alt?: string };
/** Bloc de contenu : hero, section, cards, stats, actions, plans, faq, table, h, p, ul, ol, quote… */
export type Block = { t: string; [key: string]: any };

export interface SitePageData {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  lang: string;
  blocks: Block[];
}

export interface PostHead {
  slug: string;
  lang: SiteLang;
  /** Identifiant commun aux versions en/fr/es d'un même article. */
  base: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  kicker: string;
  dateLine: string;
  date: string;
}

export interface Post extends PostHead {
  seoTitle: string;
  blocks: Block[];
  related: { badge: string; title: string; meta: string; href: string }[];
  cta: { title: string; text: string; actions: { href: string; label: string }[] } | null;
}

const DICTS: Record<SiteLang, any> = { en, fr, es };
const POSTS = postsIndex as unknown as PostHead[];

/** Langue des pages publiques : celle de l'application (cookie « lang ») ; anglais si elle n'a pas de contenu (arabe). */
export async function getSiteLang(): Promise<SiteLang> {
  const jar = await cookies();
  const h = await headers();
  const lang = pickLanguage(jar.get(LANG_COOKIE)?.value, h.get("accept-language"));
  return lang === "fr" || lang === "es" ? lang : "en";
}

/** Traducteur des textes du site : clé « section.cle », repli sur l'anglais puis sur la clé. */
export function siteT(lang: SiteLang) {
  return (key: string): string => {
    const value = lookup(DICTS[lang], key) ?? lookup(en, key);
    return typeof value === "string" ? value : key;
  };
}

export async function loadPage(name: PageName, lang: SiteLang): Promise<SitePageData> {
  const mod = await import(`@/content/site/pages/${name}.${lang}.json`);
  return mod.default as SitePageData;
}

export function plainText(nodes: Inline[] | undefined): string {
  if (!nodes) return "";
  return nodes
    .map((node) => (typeof node === "string" ? node : node.t === "br" ? " " : plainText(node.c)))
    .join("")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

/** Versions disponibles d'un article (en, et parfois fr / es). */
export function postVariants(base: string): PostHead[] {
  return POSTS.filter((post) => post.base === base);
}

/** Articles affichés dans une langue : la version traduite si elle existe, sinon l'article en anglais. */
export function listPosts(lang: SiteLang): PostHead[] {
  const bases = Array.from(new Set(POSTS.map((post) => post.base)));
  const picked: PostHead[] = [];
  for (const base of bases) {
    const variants = postVariants(base);
    const post = variants.find((v) => v.lang === lang) ?? variants.find((v) => v.lang === "en") ?? variants[0];
    if (post) picked.push(post);
  }
  return picked.sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : a.date > b.date ? -1 : a.slug.localeCompare(b.slug)));
}

export async function loadPost(slug: string): Promise<Post | null> {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(slug) || !POSTS.some((post) => post.slug === slug)) return null;
  const mod = await import(`@/content/site/posts/${slug}.json`);
  return mod.default as Post;
}
// components/site/SitePage.tsx
// Rendu d'une page publique à partir de son fichier de contenu (content/site/pages). Composant serveur.

  "labelSelectSize", "labelMessage", "placeholderFirstName", "placeholderLastName", "placeholderEmail",
  "placeholderCompany", "placeholderPhone", "placeholderMessage", "submit", "size1", "size2", "size3", "size4",
  "size5", "privacyA", "privacyB", "errRequired", "errEmail",
];

/** Les textes juridiques n'existent qu'en anglais sur le site : on le signale dans les autres langues. */
const LEGAL_NOTE: Partial<Record<SiteLang, string>> = {
  fr: "Ce texte juridique n'est disponible qu'en anglais.",
  es: "Este texto legal solo está disponible en inglés.",
};

export async function sitePageMetadata(name: PageName): Promise<Metadata> {
  const lang = await getSiteLang();
  const data = await loadPage(name, lang);
  const hero = data.blocks.find((block) => block.t === "hero");

  const heroLead = plainText(hero?.blocks?.find((block: any) => block.t === "p")?.c);
  return {

}

          <h3 className="st-card-title">{t("contact.hoursTitle")}</h3>

        </div>

export async function SitePage({ name }: { name: PageName }) {
  const lang = await getSiteLang();
  const data = await loadPage(name, lang);
  const legalNote = name === "privacy" || name === "terms" ? LEGAL_NOTE[lang] : undefined;
  return (
    <div className={"st-page st-page-" + name}>
      <Blocks blocks={data.blocks} extras={name === "contact" ? { contact: <ContactSection lang={lang} /> } : undefined} />
      {legalNote ? (
        <p className="st-wrap st-muted st-legal-note" lang={lang}>
          {legalNote}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// components/site/SiteHeader.tsx
// En-tête commun à la page d'accueil et aux pages publiques : logo, menu, bouton de langue, bouton de démo.
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useLanguage } from "@/contexts/LanguageContext";
import "./site-header.css";

interface NavItem {
  href: string;
  label: string;
}

const LANGS = [
  { code: "fr", label: "Français", flag: "fr" },
  { code: "en", label: "English", flag: "gb" },
  { code: "es", label: "Español", flag: "es" },
] as const;

const IconChevronDown = () => (
  <svg width={11} height={11} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
    <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9" />
  </svg>
);

const IconCheck = () => (
  <svg width={13} height={13} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
    <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12" />
  </svg>
);

export default function SiteHeader({
  lang,
  nav,
  cta,
  labels,
}: {
  lang: string;
  nav: NavItem[];
  cta: NavItem;
  labels: { language: string; menu: string };
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { changeLanguage } = useLanguage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showLanguageMenu, setShowLanguageMenu] = useState(false);
  const langWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const langButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  // Une langue hors liste (l'arabe, possible sur la page d'accueil) garde son code, sans drapeau.
  const currentLang = LANGS.find((item) => item.code === lang);
  const currentLabel = currentLang?.label ?? lang.toUpperCase();

  // Fermeture du menu des langues : clic en dehors ou touche Échap.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showLanguageMenu) return;
    const onPointer = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (langWrapRef.current && !langWrapRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setShowLanguageMenu(false);
    };
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setShowLanguageMenu(false);
        langButtonRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointer);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointer);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [showLanguageMenu]);

  // La langue est celle de toute l'application (cookie « lang ») : après le changement,
  // la page est redemandée au serveur pour être rendue dans la nouvelle langue.
  const handleLanguageChange = useCallback(
    async (code: string) => {
      setShowLanguageMenu(false);
      langButtonRef.current?.focus();
      if (code === lang) return;
      await changeLanguage(code);
      router.refresh();
    },
    [changeLanguage, lang, router]
  );

  const isActive = (href: string) => (href === "/" ? pathname === "/" : pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(href + "/"));

  return (
    <header className="st-header">
      <div className="st-header-row">
        <Link href="/" className="st-brand" aria-label="Inovexa ERP">
          <img src="/images/logo.png" alt="" width={40} height={40} />
          <span className="st-brand-name" lang="en" dir="ltr">
            <b>INOV</b>EXA <span>ERP</span>
          </span>
        </Link>

        <nav id="st-nav" className={"st-nav" + (open ? " is-open" : "")} aria-label="Site">
          {nav.map((item) => {
            const active = isActive(item.href);
            return (
              <Link
                key={item.href}
                href={item.href}
                className={active ? "is-active" : undefined}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              >
                {item.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="st-header-tools">
          <div ref={langWrapRef} className="st-lang">
            <button
              ref={langButtonRef}
              type="button"
              className="st-chip-btn"
              aria-haspopup="listbox"
              aria-expanded={showLanguageMenu}
              aria-label={`${labels.language} — ${currentLabel}`}
              onClick={() => setShowLanguageMenu((value) => !value)}
            >
              {currentLang ? <img src={`https://flagcdn.com/w20/${currentLang.flag}.png`} width={16} height={12} alt="" /> : null}
              <span className="st-chip-code">{lang.toUpperCase()}</span>
              <span className={"st-chevron" + (showLanguageMenu ? " open" : "")}>
                <IconChevronDown />
              </span>
            </button>

            {showLanguageMenu && (
              <ul role="listbox" aria-label={labels.language} className="st-lang-menu">
                {LANGS.map((item) => {
                  const active = item.code === lang;
                  return (
                    <li key={item.code} role="option" aria-selected={active}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        lang={item.code}
                        className={"st-lang-item" + (active ? " active" : "")}
                        onClick={() => handleLanguageChange(item.code)}
                      >
                        <img src={`https://flagcdn.com/w20/${item.flag}.png`} width={16} height={12} alt="" />
                        <span>{item.label}</span>
                        {active && <IconCheck />}
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <Link href={cta.href} className="st-header-cta">
            {cta.label}
          </Link>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="st-menu-btn"
            aria-controls="st-nav"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-label={labels.menu}
            onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
          >
            <span />
            <span />
            <span />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

        <nav aria-label={t("footer.industries")}>
          <h2 className="st-footer-title">{t("footer.industries")}</h2>
          <ul>
            {industries.map((key) => (
              <li key={key}>
                <Link href="/products">{t("footer." + key)}</Link>
              </li>
            ))}

        </nav>

        <div>
          <h2 className="st-footer-title">{t("footer.getInTouch")}</h2>
          <ul>
            <li>
              <a href="mailto:contact@inovexa-erp.com">contact@inovexa-erp.com</a>
            </li>
            <li>
              <a href="tel:+21622535181">+216 22 535 181</a>
            </li>
            <li>
              <a href="tel:+21626583168">+216 26 583 168</a>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="st-wrap st-footer-legal">
        <p suppressHydrationWarning>
          © {year} {t("footer.rights")}{" "}
          <a href="https://msai-systems.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
            MSAI Systems
          </a>
        </p>

          <Link href="/terms">{t("footer.termsOfService")}</Link>
          <Link href="/privacy#cookies">{t("footer.cookiePolicy")}</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}

import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import localFont from "next/font/local";
import { LanguageProvider } from "@/contexts/LanguageContext";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@/contexts/ThemeContext";
import { DeviceProvider } from "@/contexts/DeviceContext";
import AppBoot from "@/components/AppBoot";
import { LANG_COOKIE, deepMerge, languageDir, pickLanguage, type Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { THEMES, THEME_COOKIE, normalizeThemeId, themeCssVars } from "@/lib/themes";

const poppins = localFont({
  src: [
    { path: "./fonts/poppins-regular.woff2",   weight: "400", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/poppins-medium.woff2",    weight: "500", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/poppins-semibold.woff2",  weight: "600", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/poppins-bold.woff2",      weight: "700", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/poppins-extrabold.woff2", weight: "800", style: "normal" },
  ],
  display: "swap",
  variable: "--font-poppins",
});

const orbitron = localFont({
  src: [
    { path: "./fonts/orbitron-bold.woff2",      weight: "700", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/orbitron-extrabold.woff2", weight: "800", style: "normal" },
    { path: "./fonts/orbitron-black.woff2",     weight: "900", style: "normal" },
  ],
  display: "swap",
  variable: "--font-orbitron",
});

import fr from "@/public/locales/fr.json";
import en from "@/public/locales/en.json";
import es from "@/public/locales/es.json";
import ar from "@/public/locales/ar.json";

// @ts-ignore
import "./globals.css";
import "./theme-remap.css";

const RAW_MESSAGES: Record<Lang, any> = { fr, en, es, ar };
const MERGED_MESSAGES: Partial<Record<Lang, any>> = {};
function messagesFor(lang: Lang) {
  if (!MERGED_MESSAGES[lang]) {
    MERGED_MESSAGES[lang] = lang === "en" ? RAW_MESSAGES.en : deepMerge(RAW_MESSAGES.en, RAW_MESSAGES[lang]);
  }
  return MERGED_MESSAGES[lang];
}

const API_ORIGIN = (() => {
  try {
    return new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "https://inovexa-erp-4.onrender.com").origin;
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
})();

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: "device-width",
  initialScale: 1,
  viewportFit: "cover",
  themeColor: "#f3f4f6",
};

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Inovexa-ERP ",
  description: "Gestion complete pour votre entreprise",
  icons: { icon: "/images/logo.png" },
};

export default async function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) {
  // Next.js 16 : headers() et cookies() sont asynchrones.
  const h = await headers();
  h.get("x-nonce");

  const jar = await cookies();
  const language = pickLanguage(jar.get(LANG_COOKIE)?.value, h.get("accept-language"));
  const themeId = normalizeThemeId(jar.get(THEME_COOKIE)?.value);
  const theme = THEMES[themeId];
  const ua = h.get("user-agent") || "";
  const isMobileHint = h.get("sec-ch-ua-mobile") === "?1" || /Mobi|Android.+Mobile|iPhone|iPod/i.test(ua);

  const htmlStyle = {
    ...themeCssVars(theme),
    colorScheme: theme.mode === "light" ? "light" : "dark",
  } as React.CSSProperties;

  return (
    <html
      lang={language}
      dir={languageDir(language)}
      data-theme={themeId}
      data-mode={theme.mode === "light" ? "light" : "dark"}
      className={`${poppins.variable} ${orbitron.variable}`}
      style={htmlStyle}
      suppressHydrationWarning
    >
      <head>
        <link rel="icon" href="/logo.png" />
        {API_ORIGIN && <link rel="preconnect" href={API_ORIGIN} crossOrigin="anonymous" />}
        {API_ORIGIN && <link rel="dns-prefetch" href={API_ORIGIN} />}
      </head>
      <body>
        <AppBoot />
        <DeviceProvider isMobileHint={isMobileHint}>
          <LanguageProvider initialLanguage={language} initialMessages={messagesFor(language)}>
            <ThemeProvider initialThemeId={themeId}>
              {children}
            </ThemeProvider>
          </LanguageProvider>
        </DeviceProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
\u{FEFF}// contexts/LanguageContext.tsx
"use client";
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { LANG_COOKIE, deepMerge, intlLocale, isSupportedLanguage, languageDir, lookup } from "@/lib/i18n";

interface LanguageContextType {
  language: string;
  /** Sens d'écriture de la langue courante : "rtl" pour l'arabe. */
  dir: "ltr" | "rtl";
  isRtl: boolean;
  /** Locale Intl de la langue courante (dates, nombres) : "fr-FR", "en-US", "es-ES", "ar-TN". */
  locale: string;
  setLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
  changeLanguage: (lang: string) => Promise<void>;
  t: (key: string) => string;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType | undefined>(undefined);

// Dictionnaires déjà chargés côté client (fusionnés avec l'anglais pour le repli)
const messagesCache: Record<string, any> = {};
let englishPromise: Promise<any> | null = null;

async function fetchJson(url: string) {
  const res = await fetch(url);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} sur ${url}`);
  return res.json();
}

async function loadMessages(lang: string): Promise<any> {
  if (messagesCache[lang]) return messagesCache[lang];
  if (!englishPromise) englishPromise = fetchJson("/locales/en.json").catch(() => ({}));
  const [en, own] = await Promise.all([
    englishPromise,
    lang === "en" ? englishPromise : fetchJson(`/locales/${lang}.json`),
  ]);
  const merged = lang === "en" ? en : deepMerge(en, own);
  messagesCache[lang] = merged;
  return merged;
}

function persistLanguage(lang: string) {
  try { localStorage.setItem("language", lang); } catch { /* stockage indisponible */ }
  try { document.cookie = `${LANG_COOKIE}=${lang}; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`; } catch { /* ignoré */ }
}

/** Langue et sens d'écriture (gauche → droite, ou droite → gauche pour l'arabe) posés sur <html>. */
function applyDocumentLanguage(lang: string) {
  try {
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
    document.documentElement.dir = languageDir(lang);
  } catch { /* ignoré */ }
}

/**
 * Les traductions de la langue courante sont fournies par le serveur (app/layout.tsx) :
 * la page est rendue directement traduite, sans spinner ni téléchargement de tous les fichiers
 * fr/en/es/ar au démarrage. Les autres langues ne sont chargées qu'au moment du changement.
 */
export function LanguageProvider({
  children,
  initialLanguage = "fr",
  initialMessages = {},
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialLanguage?: string;
  initialMessages?: Record<string, any>;
}) {
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => {
    const lang = isSupportedLanguage(initialLanguage) ? initialLanguage : "fr";
    if (!messagesCache[lang]) messagesCache[lang] = initialMessages;
    return { language: lang as string, messages: initialMessages };
  });
  const requested = useRef(state.language);

  const changeLanguage = useCallback(async (lang: string) => {
    if (!isSupportedLanguage(lang)) throw new Error("Langue non supportée");
    requested.current = lang;
    persistLanguage(lang);
    try {
      const messages = await loadMessages(lang);
      // Ignore une réponse arrivée après un autre changement de langue
      if (requested.current === lang) {
        // Le sens d'écriture bascule en même temps que les textes (pas avant leur chargement)
        applyDocumentLanguage(lang);
        setState({ language: lang, messages });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Erreur chargement traductions:", error);
    }
  }, []);

  // Migration : langue choisie avant l'existence du cookie (stockée seulement dans localStorage)
  useEffect(() => {
    let saved: string | null = null;
    try { saved = localStorage.getItem("language"); } catch { /* ignoré */ }
    const hasCookie = typeof document !== "undefined" && document.cookie.includes(`${LANG_COOKIE}=`);
    if (!hasCookie && isSupportedLanguage(saved) && saved !== state.language) {
      changeLanguage(saved);
    } else {
      persistLanguage(state.language);
      applyDocumentLanguage(state.language);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const { language, messages } = state;

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: string): string => {
      const value = lookup(messages, key);
      return value === undefined || value === null ? key : value;
    },
    [messages]
  );

  const setLanguage = useCallback((lang: string) => { void changeLanguage(lang); }, [changeLanguage]);

  const value = useMemo(() => {
    const dir = languageDir(language);
    return { language, dir, isRtl: dir === "rtl", locale: intlLocale(language), setLanguage, changeLanguage, t };
  }, [language, setLanguage, changeLanguage, t]);

  return <LanguageContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</LanguageContext.Provider>;
}

export function useLanguage() {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("useLanguage must be used within a LanguageProvider");
  }
  return context;
}
// lib/i18n.ts
// Utilitaires de traduction partagés serveur / client (pas de "use client").

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = ["fr", "en", "es", "ar"] as const;
export type Lang = (typeof SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES)[number];

/** Langues écrites de droite à gauche (la page entière est alors mise en miroir : dir="rtl"). */
export const RTL_LANGUAGES: readonly Lang[] = ["ar"];

/** Nom de chaque langue, écrit dans la langue elle-même (menus de choix de la langue). */
export const LANGUAGE_NAMES: Record<Lang, string> = {
  fr: "Français",
  en: "English",
  es: "Español",
  ar: "العربية",
};

/**
 * Locale utilisée pour les dates et les nombres (Intl, toLocaleString…).
 * Arabe : « ar-TN » — mois et jours en arabe, chiffres 0-9 (usage du Maghreb).
 */
export const INTL_LOCALES: Record<Lang, string> = {
  fr: "fr-FR",
  en: "en-US",
  es: "es-ES",
  ar: "ar-TN",
};

/** Nom du cookie qui mémorise la langue (lu par le serveur pour rendre la page déjà traduite) */
export const LANG_COOKIE = "lang";

export function isSupportedLanguage(lang: unknown): lang is Lang {
  return typeof lang === "string" && (SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES as readonly string[]).includes(lang);
}

export function isRtlLanguage(lang: unknown): boolean {
  return (RTL_LANGUAGES as readonly string[]).includes(lang as string);
}

/** Sens d'écriture de la langue : valeur de l'attribut HTML « dir ». */
export function languageDir(lang: unknown): "ltr" | "rtl" {
  return isRtlLanguage(lang) ? "rtl" : "ltr";
}

/** Locale Intl de la langue de l'interface (français si la langue est inconnue). */
export function intlLocale(lang: unknown): string {
  return isSupportedLanguage(lang) ? INTL_LOCALES[lang] : INTL_LOCALES.fr;
}

/** Choisit la langue à partir du cookie, sinon de l'en-tête Accept-Language, sinon le français. */
export function pickLanguage(cookieValue?: string | null, acceptLanguage?: string | null): Lang {
  if (isSupportedLanguage(cookieValue)) return cookieValue;
  if (acceptLanguage) {
    const prefs = acceptLanguage
      .split(",")
      .map((part) => part.trim().split(";")[0].split("-")[0].toLowerCase());
    for (const p of prefs) if (isSupportedLanguage(p)) return p;
  }
  return "fr";
}

/** Fusion profonde : les clés de `over` remplacent celles de `base` (sert au repli sur l'anglais). */
export function deepMerge(base: any, over: any): any {
  if (!over || typeof over !== "object" || Array.isArray(over)) return over ?? base;
  const out: any = Array.isArray(base) ? [] : { ...(base || {}) };
  for (const key of Object.keys(over)) {
    const b = out[key];
    const o = over[key];
    out[key] =
      o && typeof o === "object" && !Array.isArray(o) && b && typeof b === "object" && !Array.isArray(b)
        ? deepMerge(b, o)
        : o;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Lit une clé « a.b.c » dans un dictionnaire ; renvoie undefined si absente. */
export function lookup(dict: any, key: string): any {
  let value: any = dict;
  for (const k of key.split(".")) {
    if (value && typeof value === "object") value = value[k];
    else return undefined;
  }
  return value;
}
"use client";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import Sidebar from "@/components/Sidebar";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useDeviceHint } from "@/contexts/DeviceContext";
import { AppShellProvider } from "@/components/ui/PageSkeleton";
import FloatingAssistant from "@/components/assistant/FloatingAssistant";

export default function DashboardLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  // Valeur initiale fournie par le serveur (User-Agent) : le contenu est placé au bon endroit
  // dès le HTML, il ne glisse plus de 280 px vers la droite après le chargement.
  const isMobileHint = useDeviceHint();
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(isMobileHint);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < 768);
    checkMobile();
    // Les transitions ne s'activent qu'après la première mesure (pas d'animation au chargement)
    const id = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => setMounted(true));
    window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(id);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    };
  }, []);

  const isAuthPage =
    pathname?.includes("/auth/login") || pathname?.includes("/auth/register");

  if (isAuthPage) return <>{children}</>;

  // Rail de 280px en desktop ; 0 en mobile (la Sidebar affiche alors sa barre du bas).
  const sidebarWidth = isMobile ? 0 : 280;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: "flex",
        minHeight: "100vh",
        position: "relative",
        background: "var(--theme-background)",
      }}
    >
      {/* Sidebar rendue UNE SEULE FOIS ici. Le layout persiste entre les pages,
          donc elle ne se remonte plus a chaque navigation (fini le reload mobile).
          Le composant se positionne lui-meme : rail fixe en desktop, barre du bas en mobile. */}
      <Sidebar />

      {/* Contenu principal */}
      <main
        id="contenu"
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          marginInlineStart: sidebarWidth,
          width: `calc(100% - ${sidebarWidth}px)`,
          transition: mounted ? "margin 0.3s ease, width 0.3s ease" : "none",
          minHeight: "100vh",
          position: "relative",
          minWidth: 0,
        }}
      >
        <AppShellProvider>{children}</AppShellProvider>
      </main>

      {/* Bouton « Chat IA » sur toutes les pages (masquable dans Paramètres › Préférences) */}
      <FloatingAssistant />

      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: `
          * { box-sizing: border-box; }

          ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--theme-surface-hover); }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #667eea; border-radius: 10px; }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #764ba2; }
        `,
      }} />
    </div>
  );
}
"use client";
/**
 * Sous-navigation d'un module regroupant plusieurs pages (RH, Clients, Paramètres…).
 * L'onglet actif se déduit de l'adresse : chemin de la page, puis paramètre `?tab=`.
 */
import React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

export interface ModuleTab { key: string; label: string; href: string; path: string; tab?: string }

export const HR_TABS: ModuleTab[] = [
  { key: "employees", label: "Employés", href: "/dashboard/hr", path: "/dashboard/hr" },
  { key: "payroll", label: "Bulletins de paie", href: "/dashboard/hr/payroll?tab=payroll", path: "/dashboard/hr/payroll", tab: "payroll" },
  { key: "leaves", label: "Congés", href: "/dashboard/hr/payroll?tab=leaves", path: "/dashboard/hr/payroll", tab: "leaves" },
  { key: "settings", label: "Paramètres de paie", href: "/dashboard/hr/payroll?tab=settings", path: "/dashboard/hr/payroll", tab: "settings" },
];

export const CLIENT_TABS: ModuleTab[] = [
  { key: "list", label: "Clients", href: "/dashboard/clients", path: "/dashboard/clients" },
  { key: "overview", label: "Fiche 360°", href: "/dashboard/crm?tab=overview", path: "/dashboard/crm", tab: "overview" },
  { key: "followups", label: "À relancer", href: "/dashboard/crm?tab=followups", path: "/dashboard/crm", tab: "followups" },
  { key: "prices", label: "Listes de prix", href: "/dashboard/crm?tab=prices", path: "/dashboard/crm", tab: "prices" },
];

export const SETTINGS_TABS: ModuleTab[] = [
  { key: "preferences", label: "Préférences", href: "/dashboard/settings", path: "/dashboard/settings" },
  { key: "company", label: "Société & fiscalité", href: "/dashboard/company", path: "/dashboard/company" },
];

export default function ModuleNav({ tabs, label }: { tabs: ModuleTab[]; label: string }) {
  const pathname = usePathname() || "";
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const tab = params.get("tab");
  // Le plus précis gagne : même chemin + même ?tab, sinon même chemin, sinon le premier onglet.
  const current =
    tabs.find((t) => t.path === pathname && t.tab && t.tab === tab) ||
    tabs.find((t) => t.path === pathname && (!t.tab || !tab)) ||
    tabs.find((t) => pathname.startsWith(t.path + "/") || t.path === pathname) ||
    tabs[0];
  return (
    <nav aria-label={label} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, borderBottom: "1px solid var(--theme-border)", marginBottom: 18, overflowX: "auto" }}>
      {tabs.map((t) => {
        const active = t.key === current.key;
        return (
          <Link
            key={t.key}
            href={t.href}
            aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
            style={{
              padding: "10px 14px", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: active ? 700 : 500, whiteSpace: "nowrap", textDecoration: "none",
              color: active ? "var(--theme-primary, #4f46e5)" : "var(--theme-text-secondary)",
              borderBottom: `2px solid ${active ? "var(--theme-primary, #4f46e5)" : "transparent"}`, marginBottom: -1,
            }}
          >
            {t.label}
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}
// lib/routeData.ts
// Préchargement des données d'une page AVANT qu'elle soit affichée.
//
// • Au chargement initial (F5, lien direct) : les requêtes partent dès que le JavaScript est lu,
//   sans attendre que React ait fini de construire la page (gain : le temps d'hydratation).
// • Au survol d'un lien de la barre latérale : les listes de la page visée sont demandées pendant
//   que la souris s'approche du clic.
// Les pages n'ont rien à changer : elles font leurs fetch habituels, et lib/apiCache.ts leur
// renvoie la réponse déjà reçue (ou en cours de réception) au lieu de refaire la requête.
// ⚠️ L'URL doit être EXACTEMENT celle utilisée par la page : `${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/chemin`.

const ROUTE_ENDPOINTS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "/dashboard": ["/users/profile", "/sales", "/purchases", "/clients", "/products", "/invoices", "/orders", "/employees"],
  "/dashboard/products": ["/categories", "/products"],
  "/dashboard/categories": ["/categories", "/products"],
  "/dashboard/stock": ["/products", "/sales", "/purchases"],
  "/dashboard/sales": ["/sales", "/products", "/clients"],
  "/dashboard/purchases": ["/purchases", "/products", "/suppliers"],
  "/dashboard/orders": ["/orders", "/clients", "/products"],
  "/dashboard/clients": ["/clients"],
  "/dashboard/suppliers": ["/suppliers"],
  "/dashboard/hr": ["/employees", "/departments"],
  "/dashboard/pos": ["/products", "/pos/today"],
  "/dashboard/objectives": ["/objectives"],
  "/dashboard/analytics": ["/sales", "/products", "/clients", "/orders", "/invoices", "/employees", "/logistics/shipments"],
  "/dashboard/finance": ["/sales", "/purchases", "/invoices", "/products", "/clients", "/suppliers", "/employees", "/projects"],
  "/dashboard/logistics": ["/logistics/client/shipments", "/transporteurs"],
  "/dashboard/profile": ["/users/profile", "/sales", "/orders", "/clients"],
};

function readAuth(): { token: string | null; userId: string | null } {
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
    let userId: string | null = null;
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("user");
    if (raw) userId = String(JSON.parse(raw)?.id ?? "") || null;
    return { token, userId };
  } catch {
    return { token: null, userId: null };
  }
}

/** Lance (sans attendre) les lectures dont la page `path` aura besoin. */
export function prefetchRouteData(path: string, opts: { includeModules?: boolean } = {}) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const base = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL;
  if (!base) return;
  const clean = path.split(/[?#]/)[0].replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/";
  const endpoints = ROUTE_ENDPOINTS[clean];
  const { token, userId } = readAuth();
  if (!token) return;
  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };
  const list = [...(endpoints || [])];
  // Modules de l'utilisateur (barre latérale), demandés une fois au chargement initial
  if (opts.includeModules && userId && clean.startsWith("/dashboard")) list.push(`/users/${userId}/modules`);
  for (const ep of list) {
    fetch(`${base}${ep}`, { headers }).catch(() => { /* la page refera la requête et gérera l'erreur */ });
  }
}

  return { ...(light ? LG_LIGHT : LG_DARK), "--lg-base": theme.background };

      const res = await fetch(`${baseURL}/auth/login`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: email.trim().toLowerCase(), password }),
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));

      if (res.ok) {
        try {
          if (remember) { localStorage.setItem("remember_email", email.trim().toLowerCase()); localStorage.removeItem("remember_email_off"); }
          else { localStorage.removeItem("remember_email"); localStorage.setItem("remember_email_off", "1"); }
        } catch { /* stockage indisponible */ }
        localStorage.setItem("token", data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(data.user));

        if (data.user.role === "admin") router.push("/admin/clients");
        else if (data.user.role === "transporteur") router.push("/transporteur/shipments");
        else router.push("/dashboard");
      } else {
        const serverMsg = Array.isArray(data?.message) ? data.message[0] : data?.message;

        else if (res.status >= 500) setError(t.serverError);
        else setError(serverMsg || t.invalidCredentials);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Erreur:", err);
      setError(t.serverError);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

--- make-migration
/**
 * Génère une migration à partir de la DIFFÉRENCE entre le schéma réel de la base et les entités.
 *
 *   DATABASE_URL=postgres://… npx ts-node -T scripts/db/make-migration.ts NomDeLaMigration
 *
 * Contrairement à `typeorm migration:generate`, le SQL produit est IDEMPOTENT (IF NOT EXISTS, blocs DO …
 * EXCEPTION) : la migration peut s'exécuter sans erreur aussi bien sur une base neuve que sur une base
 * déjà synchronisée par l'ancien mode `synchronize: true`.
 *
 * ⚠️  Relire le fichier généré. TypeORM exprime un CHANGEMENT DE TYPE de colonne par « DROP COLUMN puis ADD
 *     COLUMN », ce qui détruit les données : le script le signale, remplacez alors ces deux lignes par
 *     « ALTER COLUMN … TYPE … USING … ».
 *
 * Variable optionnelle MIGRATION_ENTITIES : glob des entités à comparer (défaut : celles du projet).
 */
import 'reflect-metadata';
import { writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';

function idempotent(query: string): string {
  let q = query.trim();
  q = q.replace(/^CREATE TABLE "/i, 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "');
  q = q.replace(/^CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "/i, 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "');
  q = q.replace(/^CREATE INDEX "/i, 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "');
  q = q.replace(/^DROP INDEX "public"\./i, 'DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "public".');
  q = q.replace(/^(ALTER TABLE "[^"]+") ADD "/i, '$1 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "');
  q = q.replace(/^(ALTER TABLE "[^"]+") DROP COLUMN "/i, '$1 DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "');
  if (/^ALTER TABLE "[^"]+" ADD CONSTRAINT /i.test(q)) {
    q = `DO $$ BEGIN ${q}; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object OR duplicate_table THEN NULL; END $$`;
  }
  return q;
}

async function main() {
  const name = (process.argv[2] || 'Migration').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '');
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL manquant');
  const entities = process.env.MIGRATION_ENTITIES
    ? [process.env.MIGRATION_ENTITIES]
    : [join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'src', '**', '*.entity.ts')];

  const ds = new DataSource({ type: 'postgres', url: process.env.DATABASE_URL, entities, synchronize: false });
  await ds.initialize();
  const plan = await ds.driver.createSchemaBuilder().log();
  await ds.destroy();

  const up = plan.upQueries.map((q) => idempotent(q.query));
  const down = plan.downQueries.map((q) => q.query).reverse();
  if (!up.length) {
    console.log('✔ Le schéma est déjà à jour : aucune migration à générer.');
    return;
  }
  const destructive = up.filter((q) => /DROP COLUMN|DROP TABLE/i.test(q));
  if (destructive.length) {
    console.warn(`\n⚠️  ${destructive.length} requête(s) destructive(s) — à relire et corriger à la main :`);
    destructive.forEach((q) => console.warn('   ' + q.slice(0, 160)));
  }

  const timestamp = Date.now();
  const className = `${name}${timestamp}`;
  const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/`/g, '\\`').replace(/\$\{/g, '\\${');
  const body = (qs: string[]) => qs.map((q) => `    await queryRunner.query(\`${esc(q)}\`);`).join('\n');
  const file = `import { MigrationInterface, QueryRunner } from 'typeorm';

/** Migration générée par scripts/db/make-migration.ts — SQL idempotent (voir l'en-tête du script). */
export class ${className} implements MigrationInterface {
  name = '${className}';

  public async up(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {
${body(up)}
  }

  public async down(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {
${body(down)}
  }
}
`;
  const out = join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'src', 'database', 'migrations', `${timestamp}-${name}.ts`);
  writeFileSync(out, file, 'utf8');
  console.log(`✔ ${up.length} requête(s) écrite(s) dans ${out}`);

## Complete Tunisian SaaS ERP — Full Audit, Development, Repair & Business Transformation

Act as a Senior Full-Stack Architect, SaaS Product Engineer, ERP Specialist, UI/UX Designer, Cybersecurity Engineer and DevOps Specialist.

Your mission is to transform my existing project into a professional, complete, scalable and commercial Tunisian ERP SaaS platform.

### 2. GENERAL OBJECTIVE

Develop Inovexa ERP into a complete Tunisian ERP SaaS solution for businesses and SMEs.

The platform must provide:
- Independent customer registration.

- Google authentication and email authentication.
- Three-day free trial.

- Subscription and payment management.
- Sector-specific product and pricing suggestions.

- Customer analytics and business analytics.
- Professional public website.

- French and Arabic support, including RTL.
