import { assertStrongPassword } from '../auth/auth.service';
import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { User } from './entities/user.entity';
import { normalizePhone } from '../../common/phone';

const MODULE_KEYS = [
  'dashboard', 'products', 'categories', 'stock', 'sales', 'purchases', 'orders', 'clients',
  'suppliers', 'invoices', 'hr', 'finance', 'logistics', 'production', 'ai', 'reports', 'analytics', 'profile', 'settings',
];

/**
 * Ce qu'une personne peut lire de son propre compte. Les secrets (mot de passe, clé de double authentification,
 * empreintes des liens envoyés par email, compteur de sessions) ne quittent jamais le serveur.
 */
export function publicProfile(user: User) {
  const {
    password: _password, twoFactorSecret: _twoFactorSecret, passwordResetHash: _passwordResetHash, passwordResetExpires: _passwordResetExpires,
    emailVerifyHash: _emailVerifyHash, emailVerifyExpires: _emailVerifyExpires, tokenVersion: _tokenVersion, googleSub,
    trialReminderStage: _trialReminderStage, renewalReminderStage: _renewalReminderStage,
    ...profile
  } = user;
  return { ...profile, googleLinked: !!googleSub };
}

@Injectable()
export class UsersService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async getProfile(id: number) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException('Utilisateur non trouvé');
    return publicProfile(user);
  }

  /**
   * Seuls quatre champs sont modifiables ici : nom, email, téléphone, nom de la société. Le rôle, les modules,
   * l'abonnement, le rattachement à une société ou le mot de passe ne se changent JAMAIS par cette route.
   */
  async updateProfile(id: number, body: { name?: string; email?: string; phone?: string; companyName?: string }) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException('Utilisateur non trouvé');
    const data = body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {};

    if (data.name !== undefined) {
      const name = String(data.name ?? '').trim();
      if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 120) throw new BadRequestException('Nom invalide (2 à 120 caractères).');
      user.name = name;
    }
    if (data.email !== undefined) {
      const email = String(data.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email) || email.length > 190) throw new BadRequestException('Email invalide.');
      if (email !== user.email.toLowerCase()) {
        const taken = await this.userRepository.createQueryBuilder('u').where('LOWER(u.email) = :email AND u.id <> :id', { email, id }).getOne();
        if (taken) throw new ConflictException('Cet email est déjà utilisé.');
        user.email = email;
        // Nouvelle adresse : elle devra être confirmée de nouveau.
        user.emailVerifiedAt = null;
      }
    }
    if (data.phone !== undefined) {
      const raw = String(data.phone ?? '').trim();
      const check = normalizePhone(raw);
      user.phone = check.valid ? check.normalized : raw.slice(0, 40);
    }
    if (data.companyName !== undefined) user.companyName = String(data.companyName ?? '').trim().slice(0, 160);

    await this.userRepository.save(user);
    return publicProfile(user);
  }

  async changePassword(id: number, oldPassword: string, newPassword: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException('Utilisateur non trouvé');

    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(String(oldPassword || ''), user.password);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Ancien mot de passe incorrect');
    }

    assertStrongPassword(newPassword);
    user.password = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await this.userRepository.save(user);

    return { success: true, message: 'Mot de passe changé avec succès' };
  }

  // Lit la configuration des modules depuis la colonne user.modules
  // (la même source que l'admin édite via /admin/clients/:id/modules)
  async getUserModules(id: number): Promise<Record<string, boolean>> {
    let user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id }, select: ['id', 'modules', 'ownerId'] });
    // Un membre d'équipe utilise les modules activés pour la société de son propriétaire
    if (user && user.ownerId) user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id: user.ownerId }, select: ['id', 'modules'] });
    const stored = (user && user.modules) || {};
    // Client jamais configuré : tous les modules actifs par défaut
    if (Object.keys(stored).length === 0) {
      const all: Record<string, boolean> = {};
      MODULE_KEYS.forEach((k) => { all[k] = true; });
      return all;
    }
    // Client configuré : on renvoie la config de l'admin ; modules cœur toujours actifs
    const result: Record<string, boolean> = { ...stored };
    result.dashboard = true;
    result.profile = true;
    result.settings = true;
    return result;
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { In, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Shipment } from '../logistics/entities/shipment.entity';
import { Transporteur } from '../transporteurs/entities/transporteur.entity';
import { SHIPMENT_STATUSES } from '../logistics/logistics.service';

/**
 * Espace du transporteur connecté : il ne voit et ne modifie que les expéditions qui lui sont confiées.
 * `accountId` est son compte de connexion ; la ligne `transporteurs` correspondante se retrouve par `transporteurs.userId`.
 */
@Injectable()
export class TransporteurService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Shipment)
    private shipmentRepository: Repository<Shipment>,
    @InjectRepository(Transporteur)
    private transporteurRepository: Repository<Transporteur>,
  ) {}

  private async ownIds(accountId: number): Promise<number[]> {
    const rows = await this.transporteurRepository.find({ where: { userId: accountId, isActive: true }, select: ['id'] });
    return rows.map((t) => t.id);
  }

  async getMyShipments(accountId: number) {
    const ids = await this.ownIds(accountId);
    if (!ids.length) return [];
    return this.shipmentRepository.find({ where: { transporteurId: In(ids) }, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' } });
  }

  async getStats(accountId: number) {
    const shipments = await this.getMyShipments(accountId);
    const count = (status: string) => shipments.filter((s) => s.status === status).length;
    return { total: shipments.length, pending: count('pending'), inTransit: count('in_transit'), delivered: count('delivered'), cancelled: count('cancelled') };
  }

  async updateShipmentStatus(id: number, accountId: number, status: string) {
    if (!(SHIPMENT_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(String(status))) throw new BadRequestException(`Statut invalide (${SHIPMENT_STATUSES.join(', ')}).`);
    const ids = await this.ownIds(accountId);
    if (!ids.length) throw new NotFoundException('Transporteur non trouvé');
    const shipment = await this.shipmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id, transporteurId: In(ids) } });
    if (!shipment) throw new NotFoundException('Expédition non trouvée');
    shipment.status = status;
    return this.shipmentRepository.save(shipment);
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Patch, Param, Body, UseGuards, Request, ForbiddenException, ParseIntPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { TransporteurService } from './transporteur.service';

import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';

/** Compte de connexion du transporteur (jamais l'identifiant d'une société). */
const account = (req: any): number => req.user.actorId ?? req.user.userId;

@ApiTags('Transporteur')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('transporteur')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class TransporteurController {
  constructor(private readonly transporteurService: TransporteurService) {}

  private assertTransporteur(req: any) {
    if (req.user.role !== 'transporteur') throw new ForbiddenException('Accès réservé aux transporteurs.');
  }

  @Get('shipments')
  async getMyShipments(@Request() req: any) {
    this.assertTransporteur(req);
    return this.transporteurService.getMyShipments(account(req));
  }

  @Get('stats')
  async getStats(@Request() req: any) {
    this.assertTransporteur(req);
    return this.transporteurService.getStats(account(req));
  }

  @Patch('shipments/:id/status')
  async updateShipmentStatus(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Request() req: any, @Body() body: { status: string }) {
    this.assertTransporteur(req);
    return this.transporteurService.updateShipmentStatus(id, account(req), body?.status);
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectDataSource, InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { DataSource, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { Transporteur } from './entities/transporteur.entity';
import { User } from '../users/entities/user.entity';
import { assertStrongPassword } from '../auth/auth.service';
import { normalizePhone } from '../../common/phone';

const EMAIL = /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/;

/**
 * Transporteurs d'une société (`clientId` = la société). Chaque transporteur a un compte de connexion (rôle
 * « transporteur ») qui ne voit que les expéditions qui lui sont confiées.
 */
@Injectable()
export class TransporteursService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Transporteur)
    private transporteurRepository: Repository<Transporteur>,
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectDataSource() private dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  async findAll(clientId: number) {
    return this.transporteurRepository.find({
      where: { clientId },
      order: { createdAt: 'DESC' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number, clientId: number) {
    const transporteur = await this.transporteurRepository.findOne({ where: { id, clientId } });
    if (!transporteur) throw new NotFoundException('Transporteur non trouvé');
    return transporteur;
  }

  private clean(data: any, forCreate: boolean) {
    const body = data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
    const name = String(body.name ?? '').trim();
    if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 120) throw new BadRequestException('Nom du transporteur requis (2 à 120 caractères).');
    const email = String(body.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!EMAIL.test(email) || email.length > 190) throw new BadRequestException('Email du transporteur invalide.');
    const rawPhone = String(body.phone ?? '').trim();
    const phoneCheck = normalizePhone(rawPhone);
    const password = body.password === undefined || body.password === null ? '' : String(body.password);
    if (forCreate || password.trim() !== '') {
      if (!password) throw new BadRequestException('Mot de passe requis pour le compte du transporteur.');
      assertStrongPassword(password);
    }
    return {
      name, email, password,
      phone: phoneCheck.valid ? phoneCheck.normalized : rawPhone.slice(0, 40),
      companyName: String(body.companyName ?? '').trim().slice(0, 160),
      address: String(body.address ?? '').trim().slice(0, 300),
    };
  }

  private async assertEmailFree(email: string, exceptUserId?: number | null) {
    const qb = this.userRepository.createQueryBuilder('u').where('LOWER(u.email) = :email', { email });
    if (exceptUserId) qb.andWhere('u.id <> :id', { id: exceptUserId });
    if (await qb.getOne()) throw new ConflictException('Cet email est déjà utilisé');
  }

  async create(clientId: number, data: any) {
    const input = this.clean(data, true);
    await this.assertEmailFree(input.email);
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(input.password, 10);

    // Le compte de connexion et la fiche transporteur sont créés ensemble, ou pas du tout.
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (em) => {
      const user = await em.save(User, em.create(User, {
        email: input.email, password: hashedPassword, name: input.name, companyName: input.companyName, phone: input.phone,
        role: 'transporteur', isActive: true, signupSource: 'admin',
      } as Partial<User>) as User);
      return em.save(Transporteur, em.create(Transporteur, {
        clientId, userId: user.id, name: input.name, email: input.email, phone: input.phone,
        companyName: input.companyName, address: input.address, isActive: true,
      }));
    });
  }

  async update(id: number, clientId: number, data: any) {
    const transporteur = await this.findOne(id, clientId);
    const input = this.clean(data, false);
    await this.assertEmailFree(input.email, transporteur.userId);
    // « status » absent du formulaire : on garde l'état actuel au lieu de désactiver le transporteur par erreur.
    const isActive = data?.status === undefined || data?.status === null || data?.status === '' ? transporteur.isActive : data.status === 'active';

    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (em) => {
      if (transporteur.userId) {
        const account = await em.findOne(User, { where: { id: transporteur.userId, role: 'transporteur' } });
        if (account) {
          account.name = input.name;
          account.email = input.email;
          account.phone = input.phone;
          account.companyName = input.companyName;
          if (account.isActive !== isActive) {
            account.isActive = isActive;
            if (!isActive) account.tokenVersion = (account.tokenVersion ?? 0) + 1; // coupe ses sessions tout de suite
          }
          if (input.password) {
            account.password = await bcrypt.hash(input.password, 10);
            account.tokenVersion = (account.tokenVersion ?? 0) + 1;
          }
          await em.save(User, account);
        }
      }
      Object.assign(transporteur, { name: input.name, email: input.email, phone: input.phone, companyName: input.companyName, address: input.address, isActive });
      return em.save(Transporteur, transporteur);
    });
  }

  async delete(id: number, clientId: number) {
    const transporteur = await this.findOne(id, clientId);
    await this.dataSource.transaction(async (em) => {
      // Les expéditions restent dans l'historique de la société, simplement sans transporteur.
      await em.query(`UPDATE "shipments" SET "transporteurId" = NULL WHERE "transporteurId" = $1 AND "clientId" = $2`, [id, clientId]);
      await em.delete(Transporteur, { id, clientId });
      if (transporteur.userId) await em.delete(User, { id: transporteur.userId, role: 'transporteur' });
    });
    return { success: true };
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Patch, Delete, Body, Param, UseGuards, ParseIntPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { AdminGuard } from '../saas/admin.guard';
import { AdminService } from './admin.service';

import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';

/**
 * Gestion des comptes clients par l'administrateur de la plateforme.
 * AdminGuard répond 403 à tout autre rôle (auparavant : 200 avec { error }, que le journal d'audit prenait pour un succès).
 * Abonnements, formules, paiements, secteurs : voir modules/saas (même préfixe /admin).
 */
@ApiTags('Administration plateforme')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('admin')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AdminGuard)
export class AdminController {
  constructor(private readonly adminService: AdminService) {}

  @Get('clients')
  async getAllClients() {
    return this.adminService.getAllClients();
  }

  @Get('clients/:id')
  async getClientById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.getClientById(id);
  }

  @Get('users/:id/modules')
  async getClientModules(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.getClientModules(id);
  }

  @Patch('clients/:id/modules')
  async updateClientModules(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Body() body: { modules: Record<string, boolean> }) {
    return this.adminService.updateClientModules(id, body?.modules);
  }

  @Post('clients')
  async createClient(@Body() body: {
    email: string;
    password: string;
    name: string;
    companyName: string;
    phone?: string;
    sector?: string;
    subscriptionDuration: number;
    seedDemoData?: boolean;
  }) {
    return this.adminService.createClient(body);
  }

  @Patch('clients/:id')
  async updateClient(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Body() body: {
    name?: string;
    companyName?: string;
    phone?: string;
    subscriptionEnd?: Date;
    isActive?: boolean;
  }) {
    return this.adminService.updateClient(id, body);
  }

  @Patch('clients/:id/extend')
  async extendSubscription(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Body() body: { days: number }) {
    return this.adminService.extendSubscription(id, body?.days);
  }

  @Delete('clients/:id')
  async deleteClient(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.deleteClient(id);
  }

  @Post('clients/:id/reset-demo-data')
  async resetDemoData(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.resetDemoData(id);
  }

  @Delete('clients/:id/demo-data')
  async clearDemoData(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.clearDemoData(id);
  }

  @Patch('clients/:id/toggle')
  async toggleClientStatus(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.adminService.toggleClientStatus(id);
  }

  @Get('stats')
  async getAdminStats() {
    return this.adminService.getAdminStats();
  }
}

import io
import os

ROOT = 'src/modules/'


def load(p):
    return io.open(p, encoding='utf-8-sig').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')


def save(p, s):
    io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n').write(s)


def rep(s, old, new, count=1):
    assert s.count(old) >= 1, ('missing', old[:100])
    assert count == 0 or s.count(old) == count, ('count', s.count(old), old[:100])
    return s.replace(old, new)


def add_import(s, line):
    """Ajoute un import après le dernier import existant."""
    if line in s:
        return s
    idx = s.rfind('\nimport ')
    end = s.index('\n', idx + 1)
    # import multi-lignes : aller jusqu'au point-virgule
    semi = s.index(';', idx)
    end = s.index('\n', semi)
    return s[:end + 1] + line + '\n' + s[end + 1:]

UPDATE_EXTRA = "['createdAt', 'updatedAt']"

import io
import re

ROOT = 'src/modules/'


def load(p):
    return io.open(p, encoding='utf-8-sig').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')


def save(p, s):
    io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n').write(s)


def rep(s, old, new, count=1):
    assert s.count(old) >= 1, ('missing', old[:100])
    assert count == 0 or s.count(old) == count, ('count', s.count(old), old[:100])
    return s.replace(old, new)


def add_import(s, line):
    if line in s:
        return s
    idx = s.rfind('\nimport ')
    semi = s.index(';', idx)
    end = s.index('\n', semi)
    return s[:end + 1] + line + '\n' + s[end + 1:]


STRIP = "import { stripProtected } from '../saas/admin.guard';"
UPDATE_EXTRA = "['createdAt', 'updatedAt']"
done = []


def step(name, fn):
    """Chaque étape est rejouable : une étape déjà appliquée est signalée et ignorée."""
    try:
        fn()
        done.append(name + ' : ok')
    except AssertionError as e:
        done.append(name + ' : IGNORÉE ' + repr(e.args)[:140])


def orders():
    p = ROOT + 'orders/orders.service.ts'
    s = load(p)
    s, n = re.subn(r"this\.orderRepository\.create\(\{[ \t]*\n[ \t]*\.\.\.data,[ \t]*\n",
                   "this.orderRepository.create({\n      ...stripProtected(data as any, ['documentId']),\n", s)
    assert n == 1, ('orders create', n)
    s, n = re.subn(r"const order = await this\.findOne\(id, userId\);[ \t]*\n[ \t]*Object\.assign\(order, data\);",
                   "const order = await this.findOne(id, userId);\n    // Le total se recalcule toujours ici ; le lien vers le document commercial n'est posé que par la conversion.\n    Object.assign(order, stripProtected(data as any, ['createdAt', 'updatedAt', 'documentId', 'total']));", s)
    assert n == 1, ('orders update', n)
    save(p, add_import(s, STRIP))


def projects():

    s = rep(s, "    Object.assign(project, data);", "    Object.assign(project, stripProtected(data as any, %s));" % UPDATE_EXTRA)

def save(p, s): io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n').write(s)
def rep(s, old, new, count=1):
    assert s.count(old) >= 1, ('missing', old[:100])
    assert count == 0 or s.count(old) == count, ('count', s.count(old), old[:100])
    return s.replace(old, new)

import io
import re


def load(p):
    return io.open(p, encoding='utf-8-sig').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')


def save(p, s):
    io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n').write(s)


def rep(s, old, new, count=1):
    assert s.count(old) >= 1, ('missing', old[:100])
    assert count == 0 or s.count(old) == count, ('count', s.count(old), old[:100])
    return s.replace(old, new)


def resub(s, pattern, new, label):
    out, n = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: new, s)
    assert n == 1, (label, n)
    return out

# Charge les identifiants PostgreSQL LOCAUX (backend/.env) sans les afficher.
# Usage : . dbenv.sh   → exporte PG_BASE (postgres://user:pass@host:port) et PGPASSWORD.
ENV_FILE="/c/inovexa-erp/backend/.env"
_get() { sed -e 's/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//' -e 's/\r$//' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -E "^$1=" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-; }
_enc() { python -c "import sys,urllib.parse;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1],safe=''))" "$1"; }
DB_HOST_V="$(_get DB_HOST)"; DB_PORT_V="$(_get DB_PORT)"; DB_USER_V="$(_get DB_USERNAME)"; DB_PASS_V="$(_get DB_PASSWORD)"
export PGPASSWORD="$DB_PASS_V"
export PG_BASE="postgres://$(_enc "$DB_USER_V"):$(_enc "$DB_PASS_V")@${DB_HOST_V:-localhost}:${DB_PORT_V:-5432}"
export PG_HOST="${DB_HOST_V:-localhost}" PG_PORT="${DB_PORT_V:-5432}" PG_USER="$DB_USER_V"
pg() { psql -h "$PG_HOST" -p "$PG_PORT" -U "$PG_USER" "$@"; }

import glob
import io

path = glob.glob('src/database/migrations/*-SaasPlatform.ts')[0]
s = io.open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')

s = s.replace("/** Migration générée par scripts/db/make-migration.ts — SQL idempotent (voir l'en-tête du script). */",
"""/**
 * Couche SaaS : essai gratuit, abonnements, paiements, secteurs d'activité.
 * Générée par scripts/db/make-migration.ts puis relue — SQL idempotent.
 *
 * Ce que fait cette migration sur une base de production existante :
 *  - AJOUTE 8 tables (sectors, sector_categories, sector_items, service_offers, platform_settings, plans,
 *    subscription_payments, support_messages) et 17 colonnes à `users`. Aucune colonne, aucune ligne existante n'est supprimée.
 *  - Remplace deux unicités « sur toute la base » par des unicités « par société » :
 *      shipments.trackingNumber  ->  (clientId, trackingNumber)
 *      invoices.operationNumber  ->  (userId, operationNumber)
 *    Les données existantes respectent déjà la nouvelle règle (elle est moins stricte) : la création des index ne peut pas échouer.
 *  - Comptes déjà présents : `expiryEnforced = false`. Leur date de fin d'abonnement n'était pas appliquée jusqu'ici ;
 *    elle ne le devient pas par surprise au déploiement. L'administrateur l'active compte par compte.
 *
 * Retour arrière : cette migration est additive, il suffit de redéployer la version précédente de l'application
 * (elle ignore les nouvelles tables et colonnes). `down` refuse de s'exécuter : il détruirait l'historique des paiements.
 */""")

for name in ('UQ_3300d7adbd17fdb51bdfd8c951e', 'UQ_d4c679011e607e520e4a465840d'):
    old = 'DROP CONSTRAINT "%s"`' % name

import { generateKeyPairSync, createSign, KeyObject } from 'crypto';
import { blockMessage, isAllowedWhenBlocked, modulesFromList, resolveAccess } from '../../src/modules/saas/account-access';
import { addMonths } from '../../src/modules/saas/subscription.service';
import { isModuleEnabled, missingModuleFor } from '../../src/modules/auth/access.guard';
import { googleVerifierDeps, resetGoogleKeyCache, verifyGoogleIdToken } from '../../src/modules/auth/google-verifier';
import { formatPhone, normalizePhone } from '../../src/common/phone';
import { stripProtected } from '../../src/modules/saas/admin.guard';
import { DEFAULT_SECTORS } from '../../src/modules/saas/saas-defaults';
import { MODULE_KEYS } from '../../src/modules/saas/account-access';

const NOW = new Date('2026-11-25T12:00:00Z');
const hours = (n: number) => new Date(NOW.getTime() + n * 3_600_000);
const owner = (over: Record<string, any> = {}) => ({ role: 'client', accountStatus: 'ACTIVE', expiryEnforced: true, signupSource: 'self', emailVerifiedAt: NOW, ...over });

describe('resolveAccess — état du compte décidé par le serveur', () => {
  it('essai en cours : ouvert, temps restant calculé avec l’horloge du serveur', () => {
    const a = resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: hours(72) }), NOW);
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ status: 'TRIAL', blocked: false, reason: null, remainingSeconds: 72 * 3600, persistExpired: false });
  });

  it('essai : exactement 72 h — encore ouvert une seconde avant, fermé à l’échéance', () => {
    const end = hours(72);
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: end }), new Date(end.getTime() - 1000)).blocked).toBe(false);
    const after = resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: end }), end);
    expect(after).toMatchObject({ status: 'EXPIRED', blocked: true, reason: 'TRIAL_EXPIRED', persistExpired: true, remainingSeconds: 0 });
  });

  it('essai sans date de fin : fermé (jamais d’essai illimité par accident)', () => {
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: null }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ blocked: true, reason: 'TRIAL_EXPIRED' });
  });

  it('abonnement actif jusqu’à son échéance, puis expiré', () => {
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ subscriptionEnd: hours(24) }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE', blocked: false, remainingSeconds: 86_400 });
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ subscriptionEnd: hours(-1) }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ status: 'EXPIRED', blocked: true, reason: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED', persistExpired: true });
  });

  it('compte antérieur au SaaS : la date dépassée ne bloque pas tant que l’échéance n’est pas appliquée', () => {
    const a = resolveAccess(owner({ subscriptionEnd: hours(-24 * 400), expiryEnforced: false, signupSource: 'admin' }), NOW);
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE', blocked: false, endsAt: null, remainingSeconds: null });
  });

  it('abonnement sans date de fin : actif sans limite', () => {
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ subscriptionEnd: null }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE', blocked: false, endsAt: null });
  });

  it('suspendu, résilié, expiré : fermés quelles que soient les dates', () => {
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'SUSPENDED', subscriptionEnd: hours(1000) }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ blocked: true, reason: 'SUSPENDED' });
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'CANCELLED', subscriptionEnd: hours(1000) }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ blocked: true, reason: 'CANCELLED' });
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'EXPIRED', statusReason: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED' }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ blocked: true, reason: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED' });
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'EXPIRED', statusReason: null, trialEndsAt: hours(100) }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ blocked: true, reason: 'TRIAL_EXPIRED' });
  });

  it('l’administrateur de la plateforme n’a pas d’abonnement', () => {
    for (const role of ['admin', 'super_admin']) {
      expect(resolveAccess({ role, accountStatus: 'SUSPENDED', trialEndsAt: hours(-1) }, NOW)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE', blocked: false });
    }
  });

  it('confirmation de l’adresse email exigée : bloque seulement les comptes inscrits seuls et non confirmés', () => {
    const opts = { requireEmailVerification: true };
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: hours(10), emailVerifiedAt: null }), NOW, opts)).toMatchObject({ status: 'TRIAL', blocked: true, reason: 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED' });
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: hours(10) }), NOW, opts).blocked).toBe(false);
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ emailVerifiedAt: null, signupSource: 'admin' }), NOW, opts).blocked).toBe(false);
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ emailVerifiedAt: null, signupSource: 'google' }), NOW, opts).blocked).toBe(false);
    // Sans l'option, rien n'est bloqué
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'TRIAL', trialEndsAt: hours(10), emailVerifiedAt: null }), NOW).blocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it('un état inconnu est traité comme ACTIVE avec ses dates (pas de blocage ni d’ouverture hasardeuse)', () => {
    expect(resolveAccess(owner({ accountStatus: 'N’IMPORTE', subscriptionEnd: hours(-1) }), NOW).blocked).toBe(true);
  });

  it('chaque motif de blocage a un message', () => {
    for (const r of ['TRIAL_EXPIRED', 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED', 'SUSPENDED', 'CANCELLED', 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED'] as const) expect(blockMessage(r).length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  });
});

describe('isAllowedWhenBlocked — ce qu’un compte bloqué peut encore faire', () => {
  it('abonnement, connexion et site public restent ouverts', () => {
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('GET', '/billing/subscription')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('POST', '/billing/payments')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('GET', '/auth/me')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('GET', '/public/plans')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('GET', '/users/profile')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAllowedWhenBlocked('GET', '/users/12/modules')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('tout l’ERP est fermé, en lecture comme en écriture', () => {
    for (const [m, p] of [['GET', '/products'], ['POST', '/sales'], ['GET', '/documents/3/pdf'], ['PATCH', '/users/profile'], ['POST', '/products/suggestions/import'], ['GET', '/billingx']] as const) {

describe('modules de l’abonnement', () => {
  it('modulesFromList : les modules de base sont toujours actifs', () => {
    const m = modulesFromList(['sales', 'pos']);
    expect(m).toMatchObject({ dashboard: true, profile: true, settings: true, sales: true, pos: true, logistics: false, production: false });
    expect(Object.keys(m).sort()).toEqual([...MODULE_KEYS].sort());
  });

  it('isModuleEnabled suit les mêmes règles que la barre latérale', () => {
    expect(isModuleEnabled({}, 'hr')).toBe(true); // compte jamais configuré
    expect(isModuleEnabled(null, 'hr')).toBe(true);
    expect(isModuleEnabled({ sales: true }, 'hr')).toBe(false);
    expect(isModuleEnabled({ sales: true }, 'objectives')).toBe(true);
    expect(isModuleEnabled({ sales: true, objectives: false }, 'objectives')).toBe(false);
    expect(isModuleEnabled({ sales: true }, 'pos')).toBe(true); // caisse = ventes ou achats si non précisée
    expect(isModuleEnabled({ sales: true, pos: false }, 'pos')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('missingModuleFor : une écriture passe si UN module de la liste est actif', () => {
    const restaurant = modulesFromList(['products', 'sales', 'pos', 'clients', 'invoices']);
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'sales')).toBeNull();
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'categories')).toBeNull(); // via « products »
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'purchases')).toBeNull(); // via « pos »
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'logistics')).toBe('logistics');
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'employees')).toBe('hr');
    expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, 'accounting')).toBe('finance');
    // Ressources jamais filtrées
    for (const path of ['company', 'team', 'users', 'billing', 'auth', 'upload', 'notifications']) expect(missingModuleFor(restaurant, path)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('chaque secteur par défaut n’utilise que des modules connus, sans la production', () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_SECTORS).toHaveLength(10);
    for (const s of DEFAULT_SECTORS) {
      for (const m of s.modules) expect(MODULE_KEYS).toContain(m);
      expect(s.modules).not.toContain('production');
      expect(s.categories.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
    expect(DEFAULT_SECTORS.find((s) => s.code === 'logistics')!.modules).toContain('logistics');
    expect(DEFAULT_SECTORS.find((s) => s.code === 'restaurant')!.modules).toContain('pos');
  });
});

    expect(addMonths(new Date('2026-11-25T10:00:00Z'), 1).toISOString()).toBe('2026-12-25T10:00:00.000Z');

  });
});

      expect(normalizePhone(v)).toMatchObject({ valid: true, normalized: '+21622535181' });
    }
    expect(formatPhone('+21622535181')).toBe('+216 22 535 181');
  });
  it('accepte un numéro étranger avec son indicatif', () => {
    expect(normalizePhone('+33 6 12 34 56 78')).toMatchObject({ valid: true, normalized: '+33612345678' });
  });
  it('refuse les numéros incomplets ou fantaisistes', () => {
    for (const v of ['1234', '12 345 678', '+216 1234', 'abc', '0612345678', '+216 02 535 181']) expect(normalizePhone(v).valid).toBe(false);
  });
  it('champ vide : valide et vide', () => {
    expect(normalizePhone('')).toEqual({ valid: true, normalized: '' });
    expect(normalizePhone(null)).toEqual({ valid: true, normalized: '' });
  });
});

describe('verifyGoogleIdToken — le jeton Google n’est jamais cru sur parole', () => {
  const CLIENT = '1234-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com';
  const { publicKey, privateKey } = generateKeyPairSync('rsa', { modulusLength: 2048 });
  const other = generateKeyPairSync('rsa', { modulusLength: 2048 });
  const b64 = (o: any) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(o)).toString('base64url');
  const seconds = Math.floor(NOW.getTime() / 1000);
  const sign = (payload: Record<string, any>, opts: { key?: KeyObject; header?: Record<string, any> } = {}) => {
    const head = b64({ alg: 'RS256', kid: 'k1', typ: 'JWT', ...(opts.header || {}) });
    const body = b64(payload);
    const sig = createSign('RSA-SHA256').update(`${head}.${body}`).sign(opts.key || privateKey).toString('base64url');
    return `${head}.${body}.${sig}`;
  };
  const claims = (over: Record<string, any> = {}) => ({ iss: 'https://accounts.google.com', aud: CLIENT, sub: '1099', email: 'Sami@Exemple.tn', email_verified: true, name: 'Sami T', iat: seconds - 10, exp: seconds + 3000, ...over });

  beforeEach(() => {
    resetGoogleKeyCache();
    googleVerifierDeps.fetchKeys = async () => ({ keys: new Map([['k1', publicKey]]), maxAgeSeconds: 3600 });
  });

  it('accepte un jeton signé par Google pour notre application', async () => {
    const id = await verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims()), CLIENT, NOW);
    expect(id).toMatchObject({ sub: '1099', email: 'sami@exemple.tn', emailVerified: true, name: 'Sami T' });
  });

  it('refuse un jeton émis pour une autre application', async () => {
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims({ aud: 'autre.apps.googleusercontent.com' })), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/autre application/);
  });

  it('refuse une signature faite avec une autre clé', async () => {
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims(), { key: other.privateKey }), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/Signature invalide/);
  });

  it('refuse un contenu modifié après signature', async () => {
    const [h, , s] = sign(claims()).split('.');
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(`${h}.${b64(claims({ email: 'pirate@x.tn' }))}.${s}`, CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/Signature invalide/);
  });

  it('refuse un jeton expiré, un émetteur inconnu, un algorithme « none » ou HS256', async () => {
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims({ exp: seconds - 3600 })), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/expiré/);
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims({ iss: 'https://accounts.exemple.com' })), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/Émetteur/);
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(`${b64({ alg: 'none', kid: 'k1' })}.${b64(claims())}.`, CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/Algorithme/);
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims(), { header: { alg: 'HS256' } }), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/Algorithme/);
  });

  it('refuse une clé de signature inconnue et un jeton mal formé', async () => {
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims(), { header: { kid: 'inconnue' } }), CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/inconnue/);
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken('pas-un-jeton', CLIENT, NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/mal formé/);
    await expect(verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims()), '', NOW)).rejects.toThrow(/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/);
  });

  it('signale une adresse non vérifiée par Google', async () => {
    expect((await verifyGoogleIdToken(sign(claims({ email_verified: false })), CLIENT, NOW)).emailVerified).toBe(false);
  });
});

function check(name, cond, extra) {
  if (cond) { passes++; console.log('  ok  ', name); }
  else { failures++; console.log('  FAIL', name, extra !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(extra).slice(0, 500) : ''); }
}
async function call(method, path, opts = {}) {
  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(opts.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.token}` } : {}) },
    body: opts.body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(opts.body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let body; try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = text; }
  return { status: res.status, body };
}

  r = await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${D.id}/extend-trial`, { token: admin, body: { hours: 48 } });
  check('l’administrateur rouvre l’essai pour 48 h', r.status === 200 && r.body.status === 'TRIAL' && r.body.remainingSeconds > 47 * 3600 && r.body.remainingSeconds <= 48 * 3600, r);
  r = await call('GET', '/products', { token: D.token });
  check('D retrouve l’accès', r.status === 200, r);
  r = await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${D.id}/activate`, { token: admin, body: {} });
  check('activer sans durée ni date : refusé', r.status === 400, r);
  r = await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${D.id}/activate`, { token: admin, body: { months: 12, planCode: 'business' } });
  check('activation manuelle pour 12 mois', r.status === 200 && r.body.status === 'ACTIVE' && r.body.planCode === 'business' && r.body.remainingSeconds > 360 * 86400, r);
  r = await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${D.id}/cancel`, { token: admin, body: { reason: 'Demande du client' } });
  check('résiliation', r.status === 200 && r.body.status === 'CANCELLED', r);
  r = await call('GET', '/products', { token: D.token });
  check('compte résilié : 402 CANCELLED', r.status === 402 && r.body.reason === 'CANCELLED', r);
  row = await one('SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM shipments WHERE "clientId" = $1', [D.id]);
  check('les données du compte résilié sont conservées', row.n === 1, row);
  r = await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${C.id}/suspend`, { token: admin, body: {} });
  r = await call('GET', '/transporteur/shipments', { token: carrierToken });
  check('le transporteur garde son accès à ses livraisons (compte distinct)', r.status === 200, r);
  await call('POST', `/admin/accounts/${C.id}/reactivate`, { token: admin });

  // ═════════════════════════ Balayage : rappels ═════════════════════════
  console.log('— Balayage périodique');
  await db.query(`UPDATE users SET "trialEndsAt" = now() + interval '2 hours' WHERE id = $1`, [B.id]);
  await db.query(`UPDATE users SET "trialEndsAt" = now() - interval '5 minutes' WHERE id = $1`, [C.id]);
  r = await call('POST', '/admin/maintenance/sweep', { token: admin });
  check('balayage : 1 essai expiré, 1 rappel avant échéance', r.status === 200 && r.body.expired === 1 && r.body.reminders === 1, r);
  r = await call('POST', '/admin/maintenance/sweep', { token: admin });
  check('second balayage : aucun rappel en double', r.body.expired === 0 && r.body.reminders === 0, r);
  row = await one('SELECT "accountStatus", "trialReminderStage" FROM users WHERE id = $1', [C.id]);
  check('C passé à EXPIRED par le balayage', row.accountStatus === 'EXPIRED', row);
  r = await call('POST', '/admin/payments', { token: admin, body: { userId: C.id, planCode: 'business', billingCycle: 'annual', method: 'cash', reference: 'Espèces au bureau' } });
  check('paiement saisi par l’administrateur (formule en brouillon autorisée, espèces) et validé', (r.status === 200 || r.status === 201) && r.body.status === 'validated' && r.body.periodMonths === 12 && r.body.amountHT === 990, r);
  r = await call('GET', '/products', { token: C.token });
  check('C réactivé par le paiement saisi par l’administrateur', r.status === 200, r);
  r = await call('GET', '/admin/overview', { token: admin });
  check('revenu récurrent : 49 + 990/12 = 131,5', r.body.mrr === 131.5 && r.body.customers.paying === 2 && r.body.customers.cancelled === 1 && r.body.cancellations === 1, { mrr: r.body.mrr, customers: r.body.customers });

  // ═════════════════════════ Sessions ═════════════════════════
  console.log('— Sessions');
  r = await call('PATCH', '/users/change-password', { token: A.token, body: { oldPassword: PASSWORD, newPassword: 'Nouveau#2026ok' } });
  check('changement de mot de passe : nouveau jeton remis', r.status === 200 && !!r.body.access_token && r.body.access_token !== A.token, r);
  const newToken = r.body.access_token;
  r = await call('GET', '/auth/me', { token: A.token });
  check('l’ancienne session est fermée (401)', r.status === 401, r);
  r = await call('GET', '/auth/me', { token: newToken });
  check('la nouvelle session fonctionne', r.status === 200, r);
  r = await call('PATCH', `/admin/clients/${B.id}/toggle`, { token: admin });
  r = await call('GET', '/auth/me', { token: B.token });
  check('compte désactivé par l’administrateur : session coupée tout de suite', r.status === 401, r);

  // ═════════════════════════ Suppression d'un compte ═════════════════════════
  console.log('— Suppression d’un compte par l’administrateur');
  r = await call('DELETE', `/admin/clients/${C.id}`, { token: admin });
  check('compte supprimé', r.status === 200 && r.body.success === true, r);
  row = await one(`SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE id = $1 OR email = 'c1@test.tn')::int AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transporteurs WHERE "clientId" = $1)::int AS carriers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments WHERE "clientId" = $1)::int AS shipments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE "userId" = $1)::int AS products`, [C.id]);
  check('ses transporteurs, leurs comptes et ses données partent avec lui', row.users === 0 && row.carriers === 0 && row.shipments === 0 && row.products === 0, row);
  row = await one('SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments WHERE "clientId" = $1)::int AS d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients WHERE "userId" = $2)::int AS a', [D.id, A.id]);
  check('les autres sociétés ne perdent rien', row.d === 1 && row.a === 1, row);

  await db.end();
  console.log(`\n${passes} ok, ${failures} échec(s)`);
  process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

import io

p = 'src/modules/saas/subscription.service.ts'
s = io.open(p, encoding='utf-8').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')

old_import = "import { DataSource, EntityManager, IsNull } from 'typeorm';"
assert old_import in s
s = s.replace(old_import, "import { DataSource, EntityManager, In, IsNull } from 'typeorm';")

a = s.index("  async adminPayments(")
b = s.index("  // ───────────── Messages à l'administrateur ─────────────")
new_payments = """  /** Paiements de tous les comptes, ceux en attente d'abord. */
  async adminPayments(f: { status?: string; userId?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number }) {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(f.limit) || 50, 1), 200);
    const offset = Math.max(Number(f.offset) || 0, 0);
    const params: any[] = [];
    const cond: string[] = [];
    if (f.status) { params.push(String(f.status)); cond.push(`"status" = $${params.length}`); }
    if (f.userId) { params.push(Number(f.userId)); cond.push(`"userId" = $${params.length}`); }
    const where = cond.length ? `WHERE ${cond.join(' AND ')}` : '';
    const [{ total }] = await this.ds.query(`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM "subscription_payments" ${where}`, params);
    const idRows: Array<{ id: number }> = await this.ds.query(
      `SELECT "id" FROM "subscription_payments" ${where} ORDER BY CASE "status" WHEN 'pending' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "createdAt" DESC, "id" DESC LIMIT $${params.length + 1} OFFSET $${params.length + 2}`,
      [...params, limit, offset],
    );
    const ids = idRows.map((r) => r.id);
    const payments = ids.length ? await this.ds.getRepository(SubscriptionPayment).find({ where: { id: In(ids) } }) : [];
    const byId = new Map(payments.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
    const ownerIds = Array.from(new Set(payments.map((p) => p.userId)));
    const owners = ownerIds.length ? await this.users().find({ where: { id: In(ownerIds) }, select: ['id', 'email', 'name', 'companyName'] }) : [];
    const ownerBy = new Map(owners.map((o) => [o.id, o]));
    const items = ids.map((id) => byId.get(id)).filter((p): p is SubscriptionPayment => !!p).map((p) => {
      const o = ownerBy.get(p.userId);
      return { ...p, account: { id: p.userId, email: o?.email ?? null, name: o?.name ?? null, companyName: o?.companyName ?? null } };
    });
    return { total, limit, offset, items };
  }

"""
s = s[:a] + new_payments + s[b:]

a = s.index("  async adminMessages(")
b = s.index("  async markMessageRead(")
new_messages = """  async adminMessages(f: { unread?: boolean; limit?: number }) {
    const messages = await this.ds.getRepository(SupportMessage).find({
      where: f.unread ? { readAt: IsNull() } : {},
      order: { createdAt: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
      take: Math.min(Math.max(Number(f.limit) || 100, 1), 300),
    });
    const ownerIds = Array.from(new Set(messages.map((m) => m.userId)));
    const owners = ownerIds.length ? await this.users().find({ where: { id: In(ownerIds) }, select: ['id', 'email', 'name', 'companyName', 'phone'] }) : [];
    const ownerBy = new Map(owners.map((o) => [o.id, o]));
    return messages.map((m) => {
      const o = ownerBy.get(m.userId);
      return { ...m, account: { id: m.userId, email: o?.email ?? null, name: o?.name ?? null, companyName: o?.companyName ?? null, phone: o?.phone ?? null } };
    });
  }

"""

git add -A backend/src backend/test start.bat demarrer.bat && git status --short | head -70 && git -c core.safecrlf=false commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
API : socle SaaS (inscription, essai 72 h, abonnements, secteurs) et isolation entre sociétés

Nouveau module backend/src/modules/saas :
- inscription libre d'une société (POST /auth/register), connexion Google (jeton
  d'identité vérifié côté serveur), confirmation d'adresse email ;
- essai gratuit de 72 h, états TRIAL / ACTIVE / EXPIRED / SUSPENDED / CANCELLED
  calculés à chaque requête avec l'horloge du serveur ; un compte bloqué reçoit 402
  partout sauf sur les routes d'abonnement, ses données sont conservées ;
- formules, paiements déclarés par le client puis validés par l'administrateur,
  reçus, rappels avant échéance ;
- 10 secteurs d'activité avec leurs modules par défaut et un catalogue de
  suggestions (valeurs indicatives) copiable dans les produits d'une société ;
- administration : tableau de bord calculé sur les comptes et paiements réels,
  comptes, formules, réglages, secteurs, journal.

Sécurité (audit du 25/11/2026) :
- création/modification : les champs id / userId / ownerId du corps de requête ne
  sont plus pris en compte (une société pouvait écraser ou s'approprier la ligne
  d'une autre dans 11 tables) ;
- PATCH /users/profile : liste fermée de champs (on pouvait se donner le rôle admin),
  et le profil ne renvoie plus les secrets (clé 2FA, empreintes de liens) ;
- /customers, /export, /search n'étaient protégés par aucune connexion ;
- garde d'accès insensible à la casse des URL ; modules de l'abonnement contrôlés
  côté serveur pour les écritures ;
- logistique : un transporteur ne lit et ne modifie que ses expéditions ; numéro
  de suivi et numéro d'opération uniques par société et non sur toute la base ;
- photo de profil : types d'image seulement, plus de suppression de fichier arbitraire ;
- routes d'administration : vrai 403 ; clé de session aléatoire si JWT_SECRET manque
  en production (plus de clé par défaut connue).

Migration 1795637150238-SaasPlatform : additive (8 tables, 17 colonnes), vérifiée
sur une base neuve et sur une copie d'une base antérieure aux migrations.
Tests : 89 tests unitaires, 481 vérifications de bout en bout (dont 197 nouvelles).

Scripts de démarrage : retrait des identifiants affichés en clair.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
MSG

---
title: useSearchParams
description: API Reference for the useSearchParams hook.
---
`useSearchParams` is a **Client Component** hook that lets you read the current URL's **query string**.
`useSearchParams` returns a **read-only** version of the [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams) interface.
```tsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.tsx" switcher
'use client'
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
export default function SearchBar() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const search = searchParams.get('search')
  // URL -> `/dashboard?search=my-project`
  // `search` -> 'my-project'
  return <>Search: {search}</>
}
```
```jsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.js" switcher
'use client'
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
export default function SearchBar() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const search = searchParams.get('search')
  // URL -> `/dashboard?search=my-project`
  // `search` -> 'my-project'
  return <>Search: {search}</>
}
```
## Parameters
```tsx
const searchParams = useSearchParams()
```
`useSearchParams` does not take any parameters.
## Returns
`useSearchParams` returns a **read-only** version of the [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams) interface, which includes utility methods for reading the URL's query string:
- [`URLSearchParams.get()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/get): Returns the first value associated with the search parameter. For example:
  | URL                  | `searchParams.get("a")`                                                                                         |
  | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `/dashboard?a=1`     | `'1'`                                                                                                           |
  | `/dashboard?a=`      | `''`                                                                                                            |
  | `/dashboard?b=3`     | `null`                                                                                                          |
  | `/dashboard?a=1&a=2` | `'1'` _- use [`getAll()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll) to get all values_ |
- [`URLSearchParams.has()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/has): Returns a boolean value indicating if the given parameter exists. For example:
  | URL              | `searchParams.has("a")` |
  | ---------------- | ----------------------- |
  | `/dashboard?a=1` | `true`                  |
  | `/dashboard?b=3` | `false`                 |
- Learn more about other **read-only** methods of [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams), including the [`getAll()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll), [`keys()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/keys), [`values()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/values), [`entries()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/entries), [`forEach()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/forEach), and [`toString()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/toString).
> **Good to know**:
>
> - `useSearchParams` is a [Client Component](/docs/app/getting-started/server-and-client-components) hook and is **not supported** in [Server Components](/docs/app/getting-started/server-and-client-components) to prevent stale values during [partial rendering](/docs/app/getting-started/linking-and-navigating#client-side-transitions).
> - If you want to fetch data in a Server Component based on search params, it's often a better option to read the [`searchParams` prop](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#searchparams-optional) of the corresponding Page. You can then pass it down by props to any component (Server or Client) within that Page.
> - If an application includes the `/pages` directory, `useSearchParams` will return `ReadonlyURLSearchParams | null`. The `null` value is for compatibility during migration since search params cannot be known during prerendering of a page that doesn't use `getServerSideProps`
## Behavior
### Prerendering
If a route is [prerendered](/docs/app/glossary#prerendering), calling `useSearchParams` will cause the Client Component tree up to the closest [`Suspense` boundary](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading#examples) to be client-side rendered.
This allows a part of the route to be prerendered while the dynamic part that uses `useSearchParams` is client-side rendered.
With [Cache Components](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cacheComponents), the boundary is client-side rendered only when the rest of the route is prerendered. If any component on the route reads request data, such as [`cookies()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/cookies), Next.js renders the boundary on the server at request time with the real search params. To keep a component that reads browser-only APIs, such as `sessionStorage`, out of the server render, use [`use(browser())`](/docs/app/guides/single-page-applications#rendering-components-only-in-the-browser) instead of relying on the `useSearchParams` boundary.
We recommend wrapping the Client Component that uses `useSearchParams` in a `<Suspense/>` boundary. This will allow any Client Components above it to be prerendered and sent as part of initial HTML.
See [Next.js encountered URL data in a Client Component outside of Suspense](/docs/messages/blocking-prerender-client-hook) for full fix options and trade-offs.
For example:
```tsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.tsx" switcher
'use client'
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
export default function SearchBar() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const search = searchParams.get('search')
  // This will not be logged on the server during prerendering
  console.log(search)
  return <>Search: {search}</>
}
```
```jsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.js" switcher
'use client'
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
export default function SearchBar() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const search = searchParams.get('search')
  // This will not be logged on the server during prerendering
  console.log(search)
  return <>Search: {search}</>
}
```
```tsx filename="app/dashboard/page.tsx" switcher
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import SearchBar from './search-bar'
// This component passed as a fallback to the Suspense boundary
// will be rendered in place of the search bar in the initial HTML.
// When the value is available during React hydration the fallback
// will be replaced with the `<SearchBar>` component.
function SearchBarFallback() {
  return <>placeholder</>
}
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <nav>
        <Suspense fallback={<SearchBarFallback />}>
          <SearchBar />
        </Suspense>
      </nav>
      <h1>Dashboard</h1>
    </>
  )
}
```

=================== page.md
---
title: page.js
description: API reference for the page.js file.
---
The `page` file allows you to define UI that is **unique** to a route. You can create a page by default exporting a component from the file:
```tsx filename="app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx" switcher
export default function Page({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
  searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>
}) {
  return <h1>My Page</h1>
}
```
```jsx filename="app/blog/[slug]/page.js" switcher
export default function Page({ params, searchParams }) {
  return <h1>My Page</h1>
}
```
## Good to know
- The `.js`, `.jsx`, or `.tsx` file extensions can be used for `page`.
- A `page` is always the **leaf** of the route subtree.
- A `page` file is required to make a route segment **publicly accessible**.
- Pages are [Server Components](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/server-components) by default, but can be set to a [Client Component](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client).
- In the [component hierarchy](/docs/app/getting-started/project-structure#component-hierarchy), `page.js` is the innermost file convention. It is wrapped by `loading.js` (Suspense boundary), `error.js` (error boundary), `template.js`, and `layout.js` in the same segment.
## Reference
### Props
#### `params` (optional)
A promise that resolves to an object containing the [dynamic route parameters](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/dynamic-routes) from the root segment down to that page.
```tsx filename="app/shop/[slug]/page.tsx" switcher
export default async function Page({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
}
```
```jsx filename="app/shop/[slug]/page.js" switcher
export default async function Page({ params }) {
  const { slug } = await params
}
```
| Example Route                        | URL         | `params`                                |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `app/shop/[slug]/page.js`            | `/shop/1`   | `Promise<{ slug: '1' }>`                |
| `app/shop/[category]/[item]/page.js` | `/shop/1/2` | `Promise<{ category: '1', item: '2' }>` |
| `app/shop/[...slug]/page.js`         | `/shop/1/2` | `Promise<{ slug: ['1', '2'] }>`         |
- Since the `params` prop is a promise, you must use `async/await` or React's [`use`](https://react.dev/reference/react/use) function to access the values.
  - In version 14 and earlier, `params` was a synchronous prop. To help with backwards compatibility, you can still access it synchronously in Next.js 15, but this behavior will be deprecated in the future.
#### `searchParams` (optional)
A promise that resolves to an object containing the [search parameters](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Learn/Common_questions/What_is_a_URL#parameters) of the current URL. For example:
```tsx filename="app/shop/page.tsx" switcher
export default async function Page({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>
}) {
  const filters = (await searchParams).filters
}
```
```jsx filename="app/shop/page.js" switcher
export default async function Page({ searchParams }) {
  const filters = (await searchParams).filters
}
```
Client Component **pages** can also access `searchParams` using React’s [`use`](https://react.dev/reference/react/use) hook:
```tsx filename="app/shop/page.tsx" switcher
'use client'
import { use } from 'react'
export default function Page({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>
}) {
  const filters = use(searchParams).filters
}
```
```jsx filename="app/page.jsx" switcher
'use client'
import { use } from 'react'
export default function Page({ searchParams }) {
  const filters = use(searchParams).filters
}
```
| Example URL     | `searchParams`                |
| --------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `/shop?a=1`     | `Promise<{ a: '1' }>`         |
=================== fetch.md
---
title: fetch
description: API reference for the extended fetch function.
---
Next.js extends the [Web `fetch()` API](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API) to allow each request on the server to set its own persistent caching and revalidation semantics.
In the browser, the `cache` option indicates how a fetch request will interact with the _browser's_ HTTP cache. With this extension, `cache` indicates how a _server-side_ fetch request will interact with the framework's persistent cache.
You can call `fetch` with `async` and `await` directly within Server Components.
```tsx filename="app/page.tsx" switcher
export default async function Page() {
  let data = await fetch('https://api.vercel.app/blog')
  let posts = await data.json()
  return (
    <ul>
      {posts.map((post) => (
        <li key={post.id}>{post.title}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```
```jsx filename="app/page.js" switcher
export default async function Page() {
  let data = await fetch('https://api.vercel.app/blog')
  let posts = await data.json()
  return (
    <ul>
      {posts.map((post) => (
        <li key={post.id}>{post.title}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```
## `fetch(url, options)`
Since Next.js extends the [Web `fetch()` API](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API), you can use any of the [native options available](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/fetch#parameters).
### `options.cache`
Configure how the request should interact with Next.js [caching](/docs/app/getting-started/caching).
```ts
fetch(`https://...`, { cache: 'force-cache' | 'no-store' })
```
- **`auto no cache`** (default): Next.js fetches the resource from the remote server on every request in development, but will fetch once during `next build` because the route will be statically prerendered. If [Request-time APIs](/docs/app/glossary#request-time-apis) are detected on the route, Next.js will fetch the resource on every request.
- **`no-store`**: Next.js fetches the resource from the remote server on every request, even if Request-time APIs are not detected on the route.
- **`force-cache`**: Next.js looks for a matching request in its server-side cache. A request matches on its URL, method, headers, and body, so requests that differ in any of these are cached separately.
  - If there is a match and it is fresh, it will be returned from the cache.
  - If there is no match or a stale match, Next.js fetches the resource from the remote server and updates the cache with the downloaded resource. Only responses with a `200` HTTP status code are stored.
> **Good to know**: Caching is opt-in. Set `cache: 'force-cache'` to cache any request, including `POST` and requests that send `authorization` or `cookie` headers. [Draft Mode](/docs/app/guides/draft-mode) bypasses the cache entirely (no read or write).
### `options.next.revalidate`
```ts
fetch(`https://...`, { next: { revalidate: false | 0 | number } })
```
Set the cache lifetime of a resource (in seconds).
- **`false`** - Cache the resource indefinitely. Semantically equivalent to `revalidate: Infinity`. The HTTP cache may evict older resources over time.
- **`0`** - Prevent the resource from being cached.
- **`number`** - (in seconds) Specify the resource should have a cache lifetime of at most `n` seconds.
> **Good to know**:
>
> - If an individual `fetch()` request sets a `revalidate` number lower than the [default `revalidate`](/docs/app/guides/caching-without-cache-components#route-segment-config-revalidate) of a route, the whole route revalidation interval will be decreased.
> - If two fetch requests with the same URL in the same route have different `revalidate` values, the lower value will be used.
> - Conflicting options such as `{ revalidate: 3600, cache: 'no-store' }` are not allowed, both will be ignored, and in development mode a warning will be printed to the terminal.
### `options.next.tags`
```ts
fetch(`https://...`, { next: { tags: ['collection'] } })
```
Set the cache tags of a resource. Data can then be revalidated on-demand using [`revalidateTag`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/revalidateTag). The max length for a custom tag is 256 characters and the max tag items is 128.
## Memoization
`fetch` requests using `GET` with the same URL and options are automatically [memoized](/docs/app/glossary#memoization) during a server render pass. If you call the same `fetch` in multiple Server Components, layouts, pages, `generateStaticParams` and `generateViewport`, Next.js executes it only once and shares the result. This is separate from persistent [caching](/docs/app/getting-started/caching): memoization lasts only for a single render pass, while cached responses persist across requests.
To opt out, pass an [`AbortController`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AbortController) signal to `fetch`:
```js
const { signal } = new AbortController()
fetch(url, { signal })
```
> **Good to know**: Memoization does not apply in [Route Handlers](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route), since they are not part of the React component tree.
## Troubleshooting
### Fetch default `auto no cache` and `cache: 'no-store'` not showing fresh data in development
Next.js caches `fetch` responses in Server Components across Hot Module Replacement (HMR) in local development for faster responses and to reduce costs for billed API calls.
By default, the [HMR cache](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/serverComponentsHmrCache) applies to all fetch requests, including those with the default `auto no cache` and `cache: 'no-store'` option. This means uncached requests will not show fresh data between HMR refreshes. However, the cache will be cleared on navigation or full-page reloads.
See the [`serverComponentsHmrCache`](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/serverComponentsHmrCache) docs for more information.
### Hard refresh and caching in development
In development mode, if the request includes the `cache-control: no-cache` header, `options.cache`, `options.next.revalidate`, and `options.next.tags` are ignored, and the `fetch` request is served from the source.
Browsers typically include `cache-control: no-cache` when the cache is disabled in developer tools or during a hard refresh.

// lib/session.ts
// Session côté navigateur : jeton, profil, déconnexion. Un seul endroit pour tous les écrans.
//
// Le navigateur ne décide JAMAIS de l'accès : l'état du compte (essai, abonnement, suspension) vient du serveur
// à chaque requête. Ce qui est gardé ici ne sert qu'à afficher vite la bonne page.
import { clearApiCache } from "@/lib/apiCache";

export const TOKEN_KEY = "token";
export const USER_KEY = "user";
const MODULES_KEY = "sidebar_modules";
/** Événement émis à la déconnexion : la barre latérale vide ses caches en mémoire (modules du compte précédent). */
export const SESSION_CLEARED_EVENT = "inovexa:session-cleared";

/** État d'un compte tel que le serveur le renvoie (auth/me, auth/login, billing/subscription). */
export interface AccountState {
  status: "TRIAL" | "ACTIVE" | "EXPIRED" | "SUSPENDED" | "CANCELLED";
  blocked: boolean;
  reason: "TRIAL_EXPIRED" | "SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED" | "SUSPENDED" | "CANCELLED" | "EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED" | null;
  message: string | null;
  trialStartedAt: string | null;
  trialEndsAt: string | null;
  subscriptionStart: string | null;
  subscriptionEnd: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  /** Secondes restantes, calculées par le serveur. */
  remainingSeconds: number | null;
  serverTime: string;
  planCode: string | null;
  billingCycle: "monthly" | "annual" | null;
  sector: string | null;
  userLimit: number | null;
  emailVerified: boolean;
  expiryEnforced: boolean;
}

export interface SessionUser {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  companyName?: string | null;
  modules?: Record<string, boolean> | null;
  isTeamMember?: boolean;
  sector?: string | null;
  twoFactorEnabled?: boolean;
  permissions?: string[];
}

export function getToken(): string | null {
  try { return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY); } catch { return null; }
}

export function getStoredUser(): SessionUser | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as SessionUser) : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** Enregistre la session renvoyée par /auth/login, /auth/register ou /auth/google. */
export function saveSession(data: { access_token: string; user: SessionUser }) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, data.access_token);
    localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.user));
    localStorage.removeItem(MODULES_KEY);
  } catch { /* stockage indisponible */ }
  clearApiCache();
  try { window.dispatchEvent(new Event(SESSION_CLEARED_EVENT)); } catch { /* ignoré */ }
}

/** Remplace seulement le jeton (après un changement de mot de passe, le serveur en remet un neuf). */
export function replaceToken(token?: string | null) {
  if (!token) return;
  try { localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token); } catch { /* ignoré */ }
  clearApiCache();
}

/**
 * Déconnexion : ne retire QUE ce qui appartient à la session. Les préférences de l'appareil (langue, thème, devise,
 * format de date) sont conservées — l'ancien `localStorage.clear()` les effaçait à chaque déconnexion.
 */
export function clearSession() {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(MODULES_KEY);
  } catch { /* ignoré */ }
  clearApiCache();
  try { window.dispatchEvent(new Event(SESSION_CLEARED_EVENT)); } catch { /* ignoré */ }
}

/** Page d'arrivée après connexion, selon le rôle et l'état du compte. */
export function homeFor(user: { role?: string } | null | undefined, account?: { blocked?: boolean } | null): string {
  if (!user) return "/auth/login";
  if (user.role === "admin" || user.role === "super_admin") return "/admin";
  if (user.role === "transporteur") return "/transporteur/shipments";
  if (account?.blocked) return "/subscription";
  return "/dashboard";
}

export const isPlatformAdmin = (role?: string | null) => role === "admin" || role === "super_admin";

export const SAAS_TEXTS: Record<string, SaasTexts> = { fr, en, es, ar };

/** Textes SaaS dans la langue de l'interface (français si la langue n'est pas couverte). */
export function useSaasTexts(): SaasTexts {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  return SAAS_TEXTS[language] || fr;
}

/** Remplace {cle} par sa valeur : fill("Essai : {time}", { time: "2 j" }). */
export function fill(template: string, values: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, key) => (values[key] === undefined ? `{${key}}` : String(values[key])));
}

/** « 2 j 5 h », « 5 h 12 min », « 12 min ». */
export function formatRemaining(seconds: number | null | undefined, tx: SaasTexts): string {
  if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined) return "";
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  if (s < 60) return tx.time.lessThanMinute;
  const d = Math.floor(s / 86400);
  const h = Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  if (d > 0) return `${d} ${tx.time.d} ${h} ${tx.time.h}`;
  if (h > 0) return `${h} ${tx.time.h} ${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${tx.time.min}`;
  return `${m} ${tx.time.min}`;
}

// Types et appels communs de la couche SaaS (formules, secteurs, abonnement). Voir docs/SAAS-API.md.
