//  - routes connectées : api("/billing/subscription") du kit   — jeton ajouté automatiquement
import type { AccountState } from "@/lib/session";

export const API_URL = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:3001").replace(/\/+$/, "");

export const MODULE_KEYS = [
  "dashboard", "products", "categories", "stock", "sales", "purchases", "pos", "orders", "clients", "suppliers",
  "invoices", "hr", "finance", "logistics", "production", "ai", "reports", "analytics", "objectives", "profile", "settings",
] as const;
export type ModuleKey = (typeof MODULE_KEYS)[number];
/** Toujours actifs, quel que soit l'abonnement. */
export const CORE_MODULES: readonly string[] = ["dashboard", "profile", "settings"];
/** Modules proposés à l'activation (la production n'a pas d'écran : elle n'est pas proposée). */
export const SELECTABLE_MODULES: ModuleKey[] = MODULE_KEYS.filter((k) => !CORE_MODULES.includes(k) && k !== "production");

/** Nom français de chaque module (écrans de l'administrateur). */
export const MODULE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  dashboard: "Tableau de bord", products: "Produits", categories: "Catégories", stock: "Stock", sales: "Ventes", purchases: "Achats",
  pos: "Caisse", orders: "Commandes", clients: "Clients", suppliers: "Fournisseurs", invoices: "Factures & devis", hr: "RH & paie",
  finance: "Finance & comptabilité", logistics: "Logistique", production: "Production", ai: "Assistant IA", reports: "Rapports",
  analytics: "Analyses", objectives: "Objectifs", profile: "Profil", settings: "Paramètres",
};

export interface Plan {
  id: number; code: string; name: string; description: string | null;
  /** Prix hors taxes ; null = sur devis. */
  priceMonthly: number | null; priceAnnual: number | null;
  /** null = illimité. */
  maxUsers: number | null;
  /** null = tous les modules. */
  modules: string[] | null;
  features: string[] | null;
  isPublic: boolean; isActive: boolean; highlight: boolean; sortOrder: number;
}

export interface PlansResponse { currency: string; vatRate: number; trialHours?: number; plans: Plan[] }

export interface Sector {
  id: number; code: string; name: string; nameEn: string | null; nameAr: string | null; description: string | null;
  modules: string[] | null; recommendations: string[] | null; isActive: boolean; sortOrder: number; itemCount: number;
}

export interface SectorCategory { id: number; sectorId: number; parentId: number | null; name: string; description: string | null; isActive: boolean; sortOrder: number }

export interface SectorItem {
  id: number; sectorId: number; categoryId: number | null; kind: "product" | "service"; name: string; description: string | null; unit: string;
  /** Montants indicatifs hors taxes (null = non renseigné). */
  purchasePrice: number | null; sellingPrice: number | null; marginPct: number | null; vatRate: number | null;
  trackLots: boolean; basis: string | null; isActive: boolean; sortOrder: number;
}

export interface ServiceOffer {
  id: number; sectorCode: string | null; category: "setup" | "training" | "migration" | "support" | "module"; name: string; description: string | null;
  /** null = sur devis. */
  price: number | null; priceUnit: "one_time" | "per_month" | "per_day" | "per_hour" | "per_user"; basis: string | null;
  isPublic: boolean; isActive: boolean; sortOrder: number;
}

export interface SectorDetail { sector: Sector; categories: SectorCategory[]; items: SectorItem[]; serviceOffers: ServiceOffer[]; disclaimer: string }

export interface PublicConfig {
  trialHours: number; currency: string; vatRate: number; requireEmailVerification: boolean;
  supportEmail: string | null; supportPhone: string | null; supportWhatsapp: string | null;
  /** null = connexion Google non configurée sur le serveur : le bouton n'est pas affiché. */
  googleClientId: string | null; modules: string[];
}

export interface SubscriptionPayment {
  id: number; userId: number; planCode: string; planName: string; billingCycle: "monthly" | "annual"; periodMonths: number;
  amountHT: number; vatRate: number; amountTTC: number; currency: string; method: string; provider: string;
  reference: string | null; note: string | null; status: "pending" | "validated" | "rejected" | "cancelled"; rejectReason: string | null;
  declaredBy: "client" | "admin"; validatedAt: string | null; periodStart: string | null; periodEnd: string | null; receiptNumber: string | null; createdAt: string;
}

export interface SubscriptionView {
  account: AccountState;
  company: { name: string | null; email: string };
  plan: Plan | null;
  users: { used: number; limit: number | null };
  modules: Record<string, boolean>;
  pendingPayment: SubscriptionPayment | null;
  payment: { currency: string; vatRate: number; instructions: string | null; methods: string[]; onlinePayment: boolean };
  support: { email: string | null; phone: string | null; whatsapp: string | null };
  /** false pour un membre d'équipe : seul le propriétaire gère l'abonnement. */
  canManage: boolean;
}

export interface Receipt {
  receiptNumber: string; issuedAt: string; planName: string; billingCycle: string; periodStart: string; periodEnd: string;
  amountHT: number; vatRate: number; vatAmount: number; amountTTC: number; currency: string; method: string; reference: string | null;
  customer: { name: string; taxId: string | null; address: string | null; email: string | null }; notice: string;
}

/** Lecture d'une route publique de l'API (sans jeton). Lève une erreur avec le message du serveur. */
export async function publicGet<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } });
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Impossible de joindre le serveur.");
  }
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok) {
    const m = (data as any)?.message;
    throw new Error(Array.isArray(m) ? m.join(" · ") : m || `Erreur ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data as T;
}

/** Envoi JSON sans jeton (inscription, connexion, mot de passe oublié). Renvoie le statut ET le corps, sans lever d'erreur HTTP. */
export async function publicPost<T = any>(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: number; data: T; message: string }> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 0, data: null as T, message: "" };
  }
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  const m = (data as any)?.message;
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, data: data as T, message: Array.isArray(m) ? m.join(" · ") : m || "" };
}

// ───────────── Formats (Tunisie) ─────────────

const INTL: Record<string, string> = { fr: "fr-TN", en: "en-GB", es: "es-ES", ar: "ar-TN" };

/** Montant en dinars : 3 décimales (millimes), « DT » en français, « TND » ailleurs, « د.ت » en arabe. */
export function formatMoney(amount: number | null | undefined, lang = "fr", currency = "TND"): string {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  const digits = currency === "TND" ? 3 : 2;
  const value = new Intl.NumberFormat(INTL[lang] || INTL.fr, { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits, numberingSystem: "latn" } as Intl.NumberFormatOptions).format(n);
  const symbol = currency !== "TND" ? currency : lang === "fr" ? "DT" : lang === "ar" ? "د.ت" : "TND";
  return `${value} ${symbol}`;
}

/** Prix d'une formule : sans décimales inutiles (« 49 DT », « 58,310 DT »). */
export function formatPrice(amount: number | null | undefined, lang = "fr", currency = "TND"): string {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  if (Number.isInteger(n)) {
    const symbol = currency !== "TND" ? currency : lang === "fr" ? "DT" : lang === "ar" ? "د.ت" : "TND";
    return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(INTL[lang] || INTL.fr, { numberingSystem: "latn" } as Intl.NumberFormatOptions).format(n)} ${symbol}`;
  }
  return formatMoney(n, lang, currency);
}

/** Date et heure à l'heure de Tunis, dans la langue de l'interface. */
export function formatDateTime(value: string | Date | null | undefined, lang = "fr", withTime = true): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(INTL[lang] || INTL.fr, {
    dateStyle: "medium", ...(withTime ? { timeStyle: "short" } : {}), timeZone: "Africa/Tunis", numberingSystem: "latn",
  } as Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions).format(d);
}

/** « +216 22 535 181 » pour un numéro tunisien enregistré au format international. */
export function formatPhone(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  const s = String(value ?? "");
  const m = /^\+216(\d{2})(\d{3})(\d{3})$/.exec(s);
  return m ? `+216 ${m[1]} ${m[2]} ${m[3]}` : s;
}

/** Nom d'un secteur dans la langue de l'interface. */
export function sectorName(sector: Pick<Sector, "name" | "nameEn" | "nameAr">, lang = "fr"): string {
  if (lang === "ar" && sector.nameAr) return sector.nameAr;
  if ((lang === "en" || lang === "es") && sector.nameEn) return sector.nameEn;
  return sector.name;
}

/** Prix TTC à partir d'un prix HT et du taux de TVA de la plateforme. */
export const withVat = (amountHT: number, vatRate: number) => Math.round(amountHT * (1 + (Number(vatRate) || 0) / 100) * 1000) / 1000;

# API de la couche SaaS

Référence des routes ajoutées par `backend/src/modules/saas` et `backend/src/modules/auth`. Toutes les réponses sont en JSON.
Les erreurs suivent le format NestJS : `{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "…" | ["…"], "error": "Bad Request" }`.

- **Montants** : nombres, hors taxes sauf mention contraire, en dinars (3 décimales). `null` = « sur devis ».
- **Dates** : chaînes ISO 8601 (UTC). L'interface les affiche à l'heure de Tunis.
- **Jeton** : `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` sur toutes les routes marquées 🔒.

## Codes de réponse à connaître

| Code | Signification | Que fait l'interface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | Pas de session, ou session fermée | Retour à `/auth/login` |
| 402 | Compte bloqué : `{ code: "SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED", status, reason, message }` | Redirection vers `/subscription` (faite une fois pour toutes dans `frontend/lib/apiCache.ts`) |
| 403 | Droit insuffisant, ou `{ code: "MODULE_DISABLED", module }` | Affiche le message du serveur |
| 409 | Conflit (email déjà utilisé, paiement déjà traité…) | Affiche le message du serveur |

`reason` vaut `TRIAL_EXPIRED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED`, `SUSPENDED`, `CANCELLED` ou `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`.
Un compte bloqué garde l'accès à `/auth/*`, `/billing/*`, `/public/*`, `GET /users/profile` et `GET /users/:id/modules`.

## Objet `account` (état du compte)

Renvoyé par `/auth/login`, `/auth/register`, `/auth/google`, `/auth/me` et `/billing/subscription`. `null` pour un administrateur
ou un transporteur.

```json
{
  "status": "TRIAL", "blocked": false, "reason": null, "message": null,
  "trialStartedAt": "2026-11-25T10:00:00.000Z", "trialEndsAt": "2026-11-28T10:00:00.000Z",
  "subscriptionStart": null, "subscriptionEnd": null,
  "endsAt": "2026-11-28T10:00:00.000Z", "remainingSeconds": 259180, "serverTime": "2026-11-25T10:00:20.000Z",
  "planCode": null, "billingCycle": null, "sector": "restaurant", "userLimit": null,
  "emailVerified": false, "expiryEnforced": true
}
```

`remainingSeconds` est calculé par le serveur : le décompte affiché part de cette valeur, jamais de l'horloge du poste.

## Authentification (sans jeton, sauf mention)

| Méthode | Route | Corps | Réponse |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/auth/register` | `name`, `companyName`, `email`, `phone`, `password`, `sector`, `acceptTerms: true` ; facultatifs : `city`, `address`, `legalForm`, `taxId` | 201 `{ access_token, user, account, emailSent }`. Tout autre champ (`role`, `modules`…) → 400 |
| POST | `/auth/login` | `email`, `password`, `otp?` | 200 `{ access_token, user, account }`. Double authentification active et pas de code : 401 `{ requires2fa: true }` |
| POST | `/auth/google` | `credential` (jeton d'identité Google), `intent?: "login" \| "register"`, et pour une inscription `companyName`, `sector`, `phone?`, `acceptTerms: true`, `otp?` | 200 `{ access_token, user, account, created }`. Aucun compte et `intent` ≠ `register` : 404 `{ code: "ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND", email, name }`. Google non configuré : 503 |
| POST | `/auth/verify-email` | `email`, `token` | 200 `{ success, message, alreadyVerified? }` |
| POST 🔒 | `/auth/resend-verification` | — | 200 `{ success, emailSent, message }` |
| POST | `/auth/forgot-password` | `email` | 200 (même réponse que le compte existe ou non) |
| POST | `/auth/reset-password` | `email`, `token`, `newPassword` | 200 `{ success, message }` |
| GET 🔒 | `/auth/me` | — | profil + `account`, `sector`, `emailVerified`, `googleLinked`, `permissions` |
| POST 🔒 | `/auth/logout-all` | — | ferme toutes les sessions |
| PATCH 🔒 | `/users/change-password` | `oldPassword`, `newPassword` | `{ success, message, access_token }` — **remplacer le jeton enregistré** par `access_token` |

`user` : `{ id, email, name, role, companyName, modules, isTeamMember, ownerId, twoFactorEnabled, permissions, sector }`.
Mot de passe : 8 caractères au moins, avec une lettre et un chiffre.

## Site public (sans jeton)

| Route | Réponse |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /public/config` | `{ trialHours, currency, vatRate, requireEmailVerification, supportEmail, supportPhone, supportWhatsapp, googleClientId, modules }` — `googleClientId: null` = ne pas afficher le bouton Google |
| `GET /public/plans` | `{ currency, vatRate, trialHours, plans: Plan[] }` — seulement les formules publiées |
| `GET /public/sectors` | `Sector[]` (avec `itemCount`) |
| `GET /public/sectors/:code` | `{ sector, categories, items, serviceOffers, disclaimer }` |
| `GET /public/service-offers?sector=` | `ServiceOffer[]` publiées |

Types : voir `frontend/lib/saas.ts` (`Plan`, `Sector`, `SectorCategory`, `SectorItem`, `ServiceOffer`).
Une sous-catégorie est une `SectorCategory` dont `parentId` désigne sa catégorie (deux niveaux au maximum).

## Abonnement de la société 🔒 (`/billing`)

| Méthode | Route | Corps | Réponse |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/billing/subscription` | — | `SubscriptionView` : `{ account, company, plan, users: { used, limit }, modules, pendingPayment, payment: { currency, vatRate, instructions, methods, onlinePayment }, support: { email, phone, whatsapp }, canManage }` |
| GET | `/billing/plans` | — | `{ currency, vatRate, plans }` |
| GET | `/billing/payments` | — | `SubscriptionPayment[]` |
| POST | `/billing/payments` | `planCode`, `billingCycle: "monthly" \| "annual"`, `method`, `reference?`, `note?` | 201 paiement `pending`. Le montant vient de la formule. Déjà un paiement en attente : 409 |
| DELETE | `/billing/payments/:id` | — | annule sa déclaration en attente |
| GET | `/billing/payments/:id/receipt` | — | `Receipt` (paiement validé seulement) |
| POST | `/billing/contact` | `subject`, `message` | 200 `{ id, received, emailed }` |
| POST | `/billing/cancel` | `password`, `reason?` | résilie (propriétaire seulement) |
| GET | `/billing/suggestions?sector=` | — | `{ sectors: [{ code, name, nameEn, nameAr, itemCount }], current, sector, categories, items, serviceOffers, disclaimer }` |
| POST | `/products/suggestions/import` | `itemIds: number[]`, `overrides?: { [itemId]: { price } }` | `{ created, skipped, products: [{ id, name }], details: [{ name, reason }], disclaimer }` |

Moyens de paiement : `bank_transfer`, `cash`, `cheque`, `d17`, `card`, `other` (ceux proposés au client sont dans `payment.methods`).
Aucun prestataire de paiement en ligne n'est branché : `onlinePayment` vaut toujours `false`, la validation est faite par l'administrateur.

## Logistique 🔒

| Méthode | Route | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/logistics/client/shipments` | expéditions de la société (tableau) |
| POST | `/logistics/client/shipments` | `clientName`*, `address`*, `trackingNumber?` (proposé si vide), `phone?`, `amount?`, `transporteurId?`, `estimatedDelivery?`, `status?` |
| PUT | `/logistics/client/shipments/:id` | mêmes champs, tous facultatifs |
| PATCH | `/logistics/client/shipments/:id/status` | `{ status }` : `pending`, `in_transit`, `delivered`, `cancelled` |
| PATCH | `/logistics/client/shipments/:id/assign` | `{ transporteurId }` |
| DELETE | `/logistics/client/shipments/:id` | |
| GET | `/logistics/stats` | `{ total, pending, inTransit, delivered, cancelled, unassigned, late, onTime, onTimeBase, onTimeRate, amount, carriers, activeCarriers, byCarrier: [{ id, name, isActive, total, delivered, inTransit, pending, cancelled, amount }], byMonth: [{ month, total, delivered, amount }] }` |
| GET/POST | `/transporteurs` | transporteurs de la société ; création : `name`*, `email`*, `password`* (8 caractères, lettre + chiffre), `phone?`, `companyName?`, `address?` |
| PUT/DELETE | `/transporteurs/:id` | modification : `status: "active" \| "inactive"`, `password` facultatif |

Le numéro de suivi est unique **par société**. Un transporteur connecté utilise `/transporteur/shipments`, `/transporteur/stats`,
`PATCH /transporteur/shipments/:id/status`.

## Administration de la plateforme 🔒 (rôle `admin` ou `super_admin`, sinon 403)

### Tableau de bord
`GET /admin/overview?from=AAAA-MM-JJ&to=AAAA-MM-JJ` (30 derniers jours par défaut) :

```json
{
  "range": { "from": "…", "to": "…" }, "currency": "TND",
  "customers": { "total": 5, "trial": 2, "active": 2, "expired": 0, "expiredTrials": 0, "suspended": 0, "cancelled": 1, "paying": 2 },
  "newRegistrations": 5, "mrr": 131.5, "revenue": { "ht": 1039, "ttc": 1236.41 },
  "revenueByMonth": [{ "month": "2026-11", "ht": 1039, "ttc": 1236.41, "payments": 2 }],
  "registrationsByMonth": [{ "month": "2026-11", "count": 5 }],
  "conversion": { "signups": 5, "signupsPaid": 2, "subscriptionRate": 40, "trialsEnded": 2, "trialsConverted": 2, "trialToPaidRate": 100 },
  "cancellations": 1,
  "plans": [{ "code": "starter", "name": "Starter", "count": 1 }],
  "modules": [{ "key": "sales", "count": 4 }],
  "sectors": [{ "code": "restaurant", "name": "Restaurants et cafés", "count": 1 }],
  "pendingPayments": 0, "unreadMessages": 0, "note": "…"
}
```

Tous les chiffres viennent des comptes et des paiements **validés**. Un taux vaut `null` quand il n'y a pas de base de calcul.

### Comptes
| Méthode | Route | Corps / paramètres |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/admin/accounts` | `q`, `status`, `sector` (`none` = sans secteur), `plan` (`none`), `source` (`self`, `google`, `admin`), `sort` (`name`, `end`, `login`), `limit`, `offset` → `{ total, limit, offset, items: [{ id, email, name, companyName, phone, sector, signupSource, createdAt, lastLoginAt, isActive, modules, account, users, paymentStatus: "pending" \| "paid" \| "none", totalPaid }] }` |
| GET | `/admin/accounts/:id` | fiche : `{ …, account, company, team: [], payments: [], activity: [], usage: { products, clients, suppliers, documents, sales, purchases, employees }, modules, twoFactorEnabled, googleLinked }` |
| POST | `/admin/accounts/:id/activate` | `{ months }` ou `{ until }` ou `{ noExpiry: true }`, `planCode?`, `billingCycle?` |
| POST | `/admin/accounts/:id/suspend` | `{ reason? }` |
| POST | `/admin/accounts/:id/reactivate` | — |
| POST | `/admin/accounts/:id/cancel` | `{ reason? }` |
| POST | `/admin/accounts/:id/extend-trial` | `{ hours }` |
| PATCH | `/admin/accounts/:id/subscription` | `planCode?` (`null` = aucune), `billingCycle?`, `subscriptionEnd?`, `userLimit?`, `expiryEnforced?`, `sector?`, `applySectorModules?` |
| PATCH | `/admin/clients/:id/modules` | `{ modules: { [clé]: boolean } }` |

Toutes ces actions renvoient l'objet `account` mis à jour. Routes d'origine conservées : `GET/POST /admin/clients`,
`PATCH /admin/clients/:id`, `/extend`, `/toggle`, `DELETE /admin/clients/:id`, `POST /admin/clients/:id/reset-demo-data`,
`DELETE /admin/clients/:id/demo-data`, `GET /admin/stats` (`{ totalClients, activeClients, expiredClients, totalRevenue }`).

### Formules, réglages, paiements, messages
| Méthode | Route | Corps |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET/POST | `/admin/plans` | création : `code`, `name`, `description?`, `priceMonthly?`, `priceAnnual?`, `maxUsers?`, `modules?` (`null` = tous), `features?: string[]`, `isPublic?`, `isActive?`, `highlight?`, `sortOrder?` |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/admin/plans/:id` | suppression refusée (409) si la formule est utilisée |
| GET | `/admin/settings` | réglages + `googleConfigured`, `paymentMethodOptions`, `moduleKeys` |
| PUT | `/admin/settings` | `trialHours`, `trialReminderHours`, `renewalReminderDays`, `requireEmailVerification`, `currency`, `vatRate`, `paymentInstructions`, `paymentMethods: string[]`, `supportEmail`, `supportPhone`, `supportWhatsapp` |
| GET | `/admin/payments` | `status`, `userId`, `limit`, `offset` → `{ total, limit, offset, items: [paiement + account: { id, email, name, companyName }] }` |
| POST | `/admin/payments` | `userId`, `planCode`, `billingCycle`, `method`, `reference?`, `note?`, `validate?` (validé tout de suite sauf `false`) |
| POST | `/admin/payments/:id/validate` | — |
| POST | `/admin/payments/:id/reject` | `{ reason? }` |
| GET | `/admin/payments/:id/receipt` | `Receipt` |
| GET | `/admin/messages?unread=1` | `[{ id, userId, subject, message, readAt, createdAt, account: { id, email, name, companyName, phone } }]` |
| POST | `/admin/messages/:id/read` | — |

### Secteurs, suggestions, prestations
| Méthode | Route | Corps |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/admin/sectors` | `Sector[]` (tous, actifs ou non) |
| GET | `/admin/sectors/:code/detail` | `{ sector, categories, items, serviceOffers, disclaimer }` (tout, actif ou non) |
| POST | `/admin/sectors` | `code`, `name`, `nameEn?`, `nameAr?`, `description?`, `modules?: string[]`, `recommendations?: string[]`, `isActive?`, `sortOrder?` |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/admin/sectors/:id` | suppression refusée (409) si des comptes y sont rattachés |
| POST | `/admin/sectors/:id/apply-modules` | applique les modules du secteur à tous ses comptes → `{ updated, modules }` |
| POST | `/admin/sectors/:id/categories` | `name`, `description?`, `parentId?`, `isActive?`, `sortOrder?` |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/admin/sectors/:id/categories/:catId` | la suppression emporte ses sous-catégories et leurs suggestions |
| POST | `/admin/sectors/:id/items` | `name`, `kind` (`product` \| `service`), `categoryId?`, `unit?`, `purchasePrice?`, `sellingPrice?`, `marginPct?`, `vatRate?` (0, 7, 13, 19), `trackLots?`, `basis?`, `description?`, `isActive?`, `sortOrder?` |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/admin/sectors/:id/items/:itemId` | coût + marge donnés sans prix : le prix de vente est calculé ; coût + prix : la marge est recalculée |
| GET/POST | `/admin/service-offers` | `name`, `sectorCode?` (`null` = toutes activités), `category` (`setup`, `training`, `migration`, `support`, `module`), `price?`, `priceUnit` (`one_time`, `per_month`, `per_day`, `per_hour`, `per_user`), `description?`, `basis?`, `isPublic?`, `isActive?`, `sortOrder?` |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/admin/service-offers/:id` | |

### Journal et maintenance
| Méthode | Route | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/admin/audit` | `action`, `userId`, `from`, `to`, `limit`, `offset` → `{ total, limit, offset, items: [{ id, userId, actorId, actorEmail, action, entity, entityId, method, path, status, ip, createdAt, details }] }` |
| POST | `/admin/maintenance/sweep` | lance tout de suite le balayage des expirations et des rappels → `{ checked, expired, reminders }` |

{
  "script": "export const meta = {\n  name: 'inovexa-saas-frontend-build',\n  description: 'Build the SaaS frontend of Inovexa ERP in parallel (auth, billing, logistics, suggestions, admin, public site), then integrate, build and document',\n  phases: [\n    { title: 'Build', detail: 'nine builders, each owning a disjoint set of files' },\n    { title: 'Integrate', detail: 'type-check, production build, HTTP smoke test, fix what breaks' },\n    { title: 'Docs', detail: 'architecture, Google OAuth, Namecheap deployment, rollback, project skill' },\n  ],\n}\n\nconst REPORT = {\n  type: 'object',\n  properties: {\n    filesCreated: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n    filesModified: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n    verified: { type: 'string', description: 'What was checked and how (tsc result, curl calls against the local API, manual reasoning)' },\n    notDone: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Anything from the brief that was not done, with the reason' },\n    needsFromOthers: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Changes needed in files you do not own' },\n    notes: { type: 'string' },\n  },\n  required: ['filesCreated', 'filesModified', 'verified', 'notDone', 'needsFromOthers', 'notes'],\n}\n\nconst COMMON = `\nYou are one of nine engineers building, in parallel, the frontend of a real commercial product: Inovexa ERP, a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Tunisian SMEs. //  CONTRÔLE D'ACCÈS (protège la clé API contre les appels anonymes)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const authCache = new Map<string, number>(); // empreinte du jeton → expiration
const rateLog = new Map<string, number[]>(); // empreinte du jeton → horodatages

const fingerprint = (authorization: string) => createHash("sha256").update(authorization).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);

async function verifySession(authorization: string | null): Promise<"ok" | "missing" | "invalid"> {
  if (!REQUIRE_AUTH) return "ok";
  if (!authorization || !/^Bearer\s+\S{10,}/i.test(authorization) || /^Bearer\s+(null|undefined)$/i.test(authorization)) return "missing";
  const key = fingerprint(authorization);
  const exp = authCache.get(key);
  if (exp && exp > Date.now()) return "ok";
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 6000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/users/profile`, { headers: { Authorization: authorization }, cache: "no-store", signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) return "invalid";
    if (res.ok) {
      if (authCache.size > 1000) authCache.clear();
      authCache.set(key, Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000);
    }
    return "ok"; // 404 / 5xx : le backend reste l'autorité sur les données, on ne bloque pas l'assistant
  } catch {
    return "ok"; // backend injoignable (démarrage à froid…) : on ne bloque pas
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

function rateLimited(authorization: string | null): boolean {
  const key = authorization ? fingerprint(authorization) : "anonymous";
  const now = Date.now();
  const list = (rateLog.get(key) ?? []).filter((t) => now - t < RATE_WINDOW_MS);
  if (list.length >= RATE_LIMIT) {
    rateLog.set(key, list);
    return true;
  }
  list.push(now);
  if (rateLog.size > 5000) rateLog.clear();
  rateLog.set(key, list);
  return false;
}

  if (session !== "ok") return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized", reason: session }, { status: 401 });

import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Sale } from '../sales/entities/sale.entity';
import { Purchase } from '../purchases/entities/purchase.entity';
import { Product } from '../products/product.entity';
import { Client } from '../clients/entities/client.entity';
import { Order } from '../orders/entities/order.entity';
import { Invoice } from '../invoices/entities/invoice.entity';
import { IaChat } from './entities/ia-chat.entity';

@Injectable()
export class IaService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Sale)
    private saleRepository: Repository<Sale>,
    @InjectRepository(Purchase)
    private purchaseRepository: Repository<Purchase>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
    @InjectRepository(Order)
    private orderRepository: Repository<Order>,
    @InjectRepository(Invoice)
    private invoiceRepository: Repository<Invoice>,
    @InjectRepository(IaChat)
    private iaChatRepository: Repository<IaChat>,
  ) {}

  async getChatHistory(userId: number) {
    return this.iaChatRepository.find({ where: { userId }, order: { createdAt: 'ASC' }, take: 50 });
  }

  async saveChatMessage(userId: number, role: string, content: string) {
    const message = this.iaChatRepository.create({ userId, role, content });
    return this.iaChatRepository.save(message);
  }

  async getAlerts(userId: number) {
    const products = await this.productRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const orders = await this.orderRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const invoices = await this.invoiceRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    
    const alerts: any[] = [];
    const lowStockCount = products.filter(p => (p.quantity || 0) < 10 && (p.quantity || 0) > 0).length;
    const outOfStockCount = products.filter(p => (p.quantity || 0) === 0).length;
    const pendingOrders = orders.filter(o => o.status === "pending").length;
    const pendingInvoices = invoices.filter(i => i.status === "pending").length;
    
    if (lowStockCount > 0) alerts.push({ type: "warning", message: `${lowStockCount} produit(s) en stock faible` });
    if (outOfStockCount > 0) alerts.push({ type: "danger", message: `${outOfStockCount} produit(s) en rupture` });
    if (pendingOrders > 0) alerts.push({ type: "info", message: `${pendingOrders} commande(s) en attente` });
    if (pendingInvoices > 0) alerts.push({ type: "warning", message: `${pendingInvoices} facture(s) impayées` });
    
    return alerts;
  }

  async getComparisonStats(userId: number) {
    const sales = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
    const currentMonthSales = sales.filter(s => new Date(s.createdAt).getMonth() === currentMonth);
    const lastMonthSales = sales.filter(s => new Date(s.createdAt).getMonth() === currentMonth - 1);
    
    const currentRevenue = currentMonthSales.reduce((s, item) => s + (item.total || 0), 0);
    const lastRevenue = lastMonthSales.reduce((s, item) => s + (item.total || 0), 0);
    const salesGrowth = lastRevenue > 0 ? ((currentRevenue - lastRevenue) / lastRevenue * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    
    return {
      salesGrowth: parseFloat(salesGrowth as string) || 0,
      clientGrowth: 5.2,
      profitGrowth: 8.3,
      avgOrderGrowth: 3.5
    };
  }

  async exportAnalytics(userId: number) {
    return { generatedAt: new Date(), message: "Export analytics" };
  }

  async getPredictions(userId: number) {
    const sales = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const totalSales = sales.reduce((s, item) => s + (item.total || 0), 0);
    const nextMonthSales = totalSales * 1.15;
    const growthRate = 15;
    
    return { nextMonthSales, growthRate, confidence: 85 };
  }

  async getForecast(userId: number, period?: string, scenario?: string) {
    const sales = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const totalSales = sales.reduce((s, item) => s + (item.total || 0), 0);
    const forecast: number[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
      const current = totalSales * (1 + (i * 0.05));
      forecast.push(Math.round(current));
    }
    
    return { forecast, period: period || "month", scenario: scenario || "normal" };
  }
}

p = 'app/api/ai/chat/route.ts'
s = io.open(p, encoding='utf-8-sig').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')

a = s.index('async function verifySession(authorization: string | null): Promise<"ok" | "missing" | "invalid"> {')
b = s.index('function rateLimited(authorization: string | null): boolean {')
new_fn = '''type SessionCheck = "ok" | "missing" | "invalid" | "blocked" | "module_disabled" | "unavailable";

/**
 * Vérifie la session auprès de l'API AVANT de dépenser un appel au modèle.
 * Refus par défaut : si l'API ne répond pas (démarrage à froid, panne), l'assistant en ligne est refusé et l'écran
 * bascule sur les réponses calculées localement. Laisser passer dans ce cas ouvrait la clé du modèle à n'importe quel
 * en-tête « Bearer » pendant que l'API dormait.
 * Un compte bloqué (essai terminé, suspension) ou sans le module « ai » n'a pas accès à l'assistant en ligne.
 */
async function verifySession(authorization: string | null): Promise<SessionCheck> {
  if (!REQUIRE_AUTH) return "ok";
  if (!authorization || !/^Bearer\\s+\\S{10,}/i.test(authorization) || /^Bearer\\s+(null|undefined)$/i.test(authorization)) return "missing";
  const key = fingerprint(authorization);
  const exp = authCache.get(key);
  if (exp && exp > Date.now()) return "ok";
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 12000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/me`, { headers: { Authorization: authorization }, cache: "no-store", signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) return "invalid";
    if (res.status === 402) return "blocked";
    if (!res.ok) return "unavailable";
    const me: any = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!me || typeof me !== "object") return "unavailable";
    if (me.account?.blocked) return "blocked";
    // Même règle que la barre latérale : compte jamais configuré = tous les modules, sinon « ai » doit être actif.
    const modules = me.modules && typeof me.modules === "object" ? me.modules : null;
    if (modules && Object.keys(modules).length > 0 && modules.ai !== true && me.role === "client") return "module_disabled";
    if (authCache.size > 1000) authCache.clear();
    authCache.set(key, Date.now() + 2 * 60 * 1000);
    return "ok";
  } catch {
    return "unavailable";
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

\u{FEFF}import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Sale } from '../sales/entities/sale.entity';
import { Product } from '../products/product.entity';
import { Client } from '../clients/entities/client.entity';
import { Employee } from '../employees/entities/employee.entity';

@Injectable()
export class ReportsService {
  private savedReports: any[] = [];

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Sale)
    private saleRepository: Repository<Sale>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
    @InjectRepository(Employee)
    private employeeRepository: Repository<Employee>,
  ) {}

  async getSalesReport(userId: number, start?: string, end?: string) {
    const sales = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const total = sales.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s.total || 0), 0);
    return { type: "sales", generatedAt: new Date(), total, count: sales.length, items: sales };
  }

  async getInventoryReport(userId: number) {
    const products = await this.productRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const totalValue = products.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.price * (p.quantity || 0)), 0);
    return { type: "inventory", generatedAt: new Date(), totalProducts: products.length, totalValue, items: products };
  }

  async getClientsReport(userId: number) {
    const clients = await this.clientRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    return { type: "clients", generatedAt: new Date(), total: clients.length, items: clients };
  }

  async getEmployeesReport(userId: number) {
    const employees = await this.employeeRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const totalSalary = employees.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.salary || 0), 0);
    return { type: "employees", generatedAt: new Date(), total: employees.length, totalSalary, items: employees };
  }

  async getLogisticsReport(userId: number) {
    return { type: "logistics", generatedAt: new Date(), total: 0, items: [] };
  }

  // Rapports sauvegardés
  async getSavedReports(userId: number) {
    return this.savedReports.filter(r => r.userId === userId);
  }

  async saveReport(userId: number, name: string, type: string, data: any) {
    const report = {
      id: Date.now(),
      userId,
      name,
      type,
      data,
      createdAt: new Date()
    };
    this.savedReports.push(report);
    return { success: true, message: 'Rapport sauvegardé', report };
  }

  async deleteSavedReport(id: number, userId: number) {
    const index = this.savedReports.findIndex(r => r.id === id && r.userId === userId);
    if (index !== -1) {
      this.savedReports.splice(index, 1);
      return { success: true, message: 'Rapport supprimé' };
    }
    return { success: false, message: 'Rapport non trouvé' };
  }
}

\u{FEFF}import { Controller, Get, Post, Delete, Body, Param, Query, UseGuards, Request } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { ReportsService } from './reports.service';

import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
@ApiTags('Rapports')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('reports')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class ReportsController {
  constructor(private readonly reportsService: ReportsService) {}

  @Get('sales')
  async getSalesReport(@Request() req: any, @Query('start') start?: string, @Query('end') end?: string) {
    return this.reportsService.getSalesReport(req.user.userId, start, end);
  }

  @Get('inventory')
  async getInventoryReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getInventoryReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('clients')
  async getClientsReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getClientsReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('employees')
  async getEmployeesReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getEmployeesReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('logistics')
  async getLogisticsReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getLogisticsReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('saved')
  async getSavedReports(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getSavedReports(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Post('saved')
  async saveReport(@Request() req: any, @Body() body: { name: string; type: string; data: any }) {
    return this.reportsService.saveReport(req.user.userId, body.name, body.type, body.data);
  }

  @Delete('saved/:id')
  async deleteSavedReport(@Param('id') id: string, @Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.deleteSavedReport(parseInt(id), req.user.userId);
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Sale } from '../sales/entities/sale.entity';
import { Purchase } from '../purchases/entities/purchase.entity';
import { Product } from '../products/product.entity';
import { Client } from '../clients/entities/client.entity';
import { Order } from '../orders/entities/order.entity';
import { Invoice } from '../invoices/entities/invoice.entity';
import { IaChat } from './entities/ia-chat.entity';

const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
/** Les colonnes « decimal » arrivent en texte : toujours convertir avant d'additionner. */
const num = (v: unknown) => Number(v) || 0;
const monthKey = (d: Date) => `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const shiftMonth = (from: Date, delta: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(from.getUTCFullYear(), from.getUTCMonth() + delta, 1));
/** Évolution en % de `previous` à `current` ; null quand il n'y a pas de base de comparaison (jamais un chiffre inventé). */
const growth = (current: number, previous: number): number | null => (previous > 0 ? Math.round(((current - previous) / previous) * 1000) / 10 : null);

/**
 * Indicateurs simples calculés sur les données réelles de la société. Aucune valeur n'est fixée dans le code :
 * quand l'historique est trop court pour calculer, la réponse vaut null et dit pourquoi.
 */
@Injectable()
export class IaService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Sale)
    private saleRepository: Repository<Sale>,
    @InjectRepository(Purchase)
    private purchaseRepository: Repository<Purchase>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
    @InjectRepository(Order)
    private orderRepository: Repository<Order>,
    @InjectRepository(Invoice)
    private invoiceRepository: Repository<Invoice>,
    @InjectRepository(IaChat)
    private iaChatRepository: Repository<IaChat>,
  ) {}

  async getChatHistory(userId: number) {
    return this.iaChatRepository.find({ where: { userId }, order: { createdAt: 'ASC' }, take: 50 });
  }

  async saveChatMessage(userId: number, role: string, content: string) {
    if (!['user', 'assistant'].includes(String(role))) throw new BadRequestException('Rôle invalide (user ou assistant).');
    const text = String(content ?? '');
    if (!text.trim() || text.length > 20_000) throw new BadRequestException('Message vide ou trop long (20 000 caractères maximum).');
    const message = this.iaChatRepository.create({ userId, role, content: text });
    return this.iaChatRepository.save(message);
  }

  async getAlerts(userId: number) {
    const products = await this.productRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const orders = await this.orderRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const invoices = await this.invoiceRepository.find({ where: { userId } });

    const alerts: any[] = [];
    // Seuil d'alerte propre à chaque produit ; les prestations (non stockées) ne comptent pas.
    const stocked = products.filter((p) => p.isStockable !== false);
    const outOfStockCount = stocked.filter((p) => num(p.quantity) <= 0).length;
    const lowStockCount = stocked.filter((p) => num(p.quantity) > 0 && num(p.quantity) <= num(p.minStock)).length;
    const pendingOrders = orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'pending').length;
    const pendingInvoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.status === 'pending').length;

    if (lowStockCount > 0) alerts.push({ type: 'warning', message: `${lowStockCount} produit(s) en stock faible` });
    if (outOfStockCount > 0) alerts.push({ type: 'danger', message: `${outOfStockCount} produit(s) en rupture` });
    if (pendingOrders > 0) alerts.push({ type: 'info', message: `${pendingOrders} commande(s) en attente` });
    if (pendingInvoices > 0) alerts.push({ type: 'warning', message: `${pendingInvoices} facture(s) impayées` });

    return alerts;
  }

  /** Chiffre d'affaires par mois (ventes non annulées). */
  private async monthlySales(userId: number): Promise<Map<string, { total: number; count: number }>> {
    const sales = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const map = new Map<string, { total: number; count: number }>();
    for (const s of sales) {
      if (s.status === 'cancelled') continue;
      const key = monthKey(new Date(s.createdAt));
      const slot = map.get(key) || { total: 0, count: 0 };
      slot.total += num(s.total);
      slot.count += 1;
      map.set(key, slot);
    }
    return map;
  }

  /** Mois en cours comparé au mois précédent (l'ancien calcul mélangeait les années). */
  async getComparisonStats(userId: number) {
    const now = new Date();
    const current = monthKey(now);
    const previous = monthKey(shiftMonth(now, -1));
    const sales = await this.monthlySales(userId);
    const cur = sales.get(current) || { total: 0, count: 0 };
    const prev = sales.get(previous) || { total: 0, count: 0 };

    const purchases = await this.purchaseRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const bought = (key: string) => purchases.filter((p) => p.status !== 'cancelled' && monthKey(new Date(p.createdAt)) === key).reduce((sum, p) => sum + num(p.total), 0);
    const clients = await this.clientRepository.find({ where: { userId }, select: ['id', 'createdAt'] });
    const newClients = (key: string) => clients.filter((c) => monthKey(new Date(c.createdAt)) === key).length;

    return {
      period: { current, previous },
      salesGrowth: growth(cur.total, prev.total),
      clientGrowth: growth(newClients(current), newClients(previous)),
      // Marge brute simple : ventes − achats du mois (les charges ne sont pas comptées ici).
      profitGrowth: growth(cur.total - bought(current), prev.total - bought(previous)),
      avgOrderGrowth: growth(cur.count ? cur.total / cur.count : 0, prev.count ? prev.total / prev.count : 0),
      note: 'Évolutions calculées sur vos ventes et achats. null = pas de mois précédent comparable.',
    };
  }

  async exportAnalytics(userId: number) {
    const [sales, purchases, clients, products] = await Promise.all([
      this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId } }),
      this.purchaseRepository.find({ where: { userId } }),
      this.clientRepository.count({ where: { userId } }),
      this.productRepository.count({ where: { userId } }),
    ]);
    const live = <T extends { status?: string }>(rows: T[]) => rows.filter((r) => r.status !== 'cancelled');
    return {
      generatedAt: new Date(),
      sales: { count: live(sales).length, total: round2(live(sales).reduce((sum, s) => sum + num(s.total), 0)) },
      purchases: { count: live(purchases).length, total: round2(live(purchases).reduce((sum, p) => sum + num(p.total), 0)) },
      clients,
      products,
    };
  }

  /** Les N derniers mois COMPLETS (le mois en cours, incomplet, est exclu), du plus ancien au plus récent. */
  private async completeMonths(userId: number, count: number): Promise<Array<{ month: string; total: number }>> {
    const sales = await this.monthlySales(userId);
    const now = new Date();
    const firstKey = Array.from(sales.keys()).sort()[0];
    const out: Array<{ month: string; total: number }> = [];
    for (let i = count; i >= 1; i--) {
      const key = monthKey(shiftMonth(now, -i));
      if (firstKey && key >= firstKey) out.push({ month: key, total: round2(sales.get(key)?.total || 0) });
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Estimation du mois prochain = moyenne des 3 derniers mois complets. Méthode volontairement simple et affichée :
   * ce n'est pas un modèle statistique, donc aucun « indice de confiance » n'est fourni.
   */
  async getPredictions(userId: number) {
    const months = await this.completeMonths(userId, 6);
    if (months.length < 2) {
      return { nextMonthSales: null, growthRate: null, confidence: null, basisMonths: months.length, method: null, reason: 'Historique insuffisant : il faut au moins deux mois complets de ventes.' };
    }
    const last = months.slice(-3);
    const before = months.slice(0, -3);
    const avg = (rows: Array<{ total: number }>) => (rows.length ? rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.total, 0) / rows.length : 0);
    return {
      nextMonthSales: round2(avg(last)),
      growthRate: before.length ? growth(avg(last), avg(before)) : null,
      confidence: null,
      basisMonths: last.length,
      method: `Moyenne des ${last.length} derniers mois complets`,
      history: months,
    };
  }

  /** Projection sur 6 mois par tendance linéaire (moindres carrés) sur les 12 derniers mois complets au plus. */
  async getForecast(userId: number, period?: string, scenario?: string) {
    const months = await this.completeMonths(userId, 12);
    const base = { period: period || 'month', scenario: scenario || 'normal' };
    if (months.length < 3) {
      return { ...base, forecast: [], method: null, reason: 'Historique insuffisant : il faut au moins trois mois complets de ventes.', history: months };
    }
    const n = months.length;
    const xs = months.map((_, i) => i);
    const ys = months.map((m) => m.total);
    const mx = xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
    const my = ys.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
    const denom = xs.reduce((sum, x) => sum + (x - mx) ** 2, 0);
    const slope = denom ? xs.reduce((sum, x, i) => sum + (x - mx) * (ys[i] - my), 0) / denom : 0;
    const intercept = my - slope * mx;
    // Scénarios : la tendance est conservée telle quelle (normal), prudente (pente réduite de moitié si elle monte) ou optimiste.
    const factor = scenario === 'pessimistic' ? 0.5 : scenario === 'optimistic' ? 1.5 : 1;
    const adjusted = slope >= 0 ? slope * factor : slope / factor;
    const forecast: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) forecast.push(Math.max(0, Math.round(intercept + slope * (n - 1) + adjusted * i)));
    return { ...base, forecast, method: `Tendance linéaire sur ${n} mois complets`, monthlyTrend: round2(adjusted), history: months };
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Sale } from '../sales/entities/sale.entity';
import { Product } from '../products/product.entity';
import { Client } from '../clients/entities/client.entity';
import { Employee } from '../employees/entities/employee.entity';
import { Shipment } from '../logistics/entities/shipment.entity';
import { SavedReport } from './entities/saved-report.entity';

/** Les colonnes « decimal » arrivent en texte : toujours convertir avant d'additionner (sinon « 0 » + « 12.50 » = « 012.50 »). */
const num = (v: unknown) => Number(v) || 0;
const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
const MAX_SAVED = 200;
const MAX_BYTES = 500_000;

@Injectable()
export class ReportsService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Sale)
    private saleRepository: Repository<Sale>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
    @InjectRepository(Employee)
    private employeeRepository: Repository<Employee>,
    @InjectRepository(Shipment)
    private shipmentRepository: Repository<Shipment>,
    @InjectRepository(SavedReport)
    private savedRepository: Repository<SavedReport>,
  ) {}

  private parseDate(value: string | undefined, endOfDay: boolean): Date | null {
    if (!value) return null;
    const d = new Date(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? `${value}T${endOfDay ? '23:59:59.999' : '00:00:00.000'}Z` : value);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) throw new BadRequestException('Date invalide (format AAAA-MM-JJ).');
    return d;
  }

  async getSalesReport(userId: number, start?: string, end?: string) {
    const from = this.parseDate(start, false);
    const to = this.parseDate(end, true);
    const all = await this.saleRepository.find({ where: { userId }, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' } });
    const sales = all.filter((s) => {
      const t = new Date(s.createdAt).getTime();
      return (!from || t >= from.getTime()) && (!to || t <= to.getTime());
    });
    const total = round2(sales.filter((s) => s.status !== 'cancelled').reduce((sum, s) => sum + num(s.total), 0));
    return { type: 'sales', generatedAt: new Date(), period: { start: from, end: to }, total, count: sales.length, items: sales };
  }

  async getInventoryReport(userId: number) {
    const products = await this.productRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    const stocked = products.filter((p) => p.isStockable !== false);
    // Deux valeurs distinctes : au coût moyen (valeur comptable du stock) et au prix de vente (chiffre d'affaires potentiel).
    const valueAtCost = round2(stocked.reduce((sum, p) => sum + num(p.avgCost) * num(p.quantity), 0));
    const valueAtPrice = round2(stocked.reduce((sum, p) => sum + num(p.price) * num(p.quantity), 0));
    return { type: 'inventory', generatedAt: new Date(), totalProducts: products.length, totalValue: valueAtPrice, valueAtPrice, valueAtCost, items: products };
  }

  async getClientsReport(userId: number) {
    const clients = await this.clientRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    return { type: 'clients', generatedAt: new Date(), total: clients.length, items: clients };
  }

  /** `withSalaries` = false pour un membre d'équipe sans droit RH : il voit l'effectif, pas les salaires. */
  async getEmployeesReport(userId: number, withSalaries = true) {
    const employees = await this.employeeRepository.find({ where: { userId } });
    if (!withSalaries) {
      const items = employees.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, name: e.name, position: e.position, department: e.department, status: e.status }));
      return { type: 'employees', generatedAt: new Date(), total: employees.length, totalSalary: null, items };
    }
    const totalSalary = round2(employees.reduce((sum, e) => sum + num(e.salary), 0));
    return { type: 'employees', generatedAt: new Date(), total: employees.length, totalSalary, items: employees };
  }

  async getLogisticsReport(userId: number) {
    const shipments = await this.shipmentRepository.find({ where: { clientId: userId }, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' } });
    const count = (status: string) => shipments.filter((s) => s.status === status).length;
    return {
      type: 'logistics', generatedAt: new Date(), total: shipments.length,
      pending: count('pending'), inTransit: count('in_transit'), delivered: count('delivered'), cancelled: count('cancelled'),
      amount: round2(shipments.reduce((sum, s) => sum + num(s.amount), 0)),
      items: shipments,
    };
  }

  // ───────────── Rapports enregistrés (en base, par société) ─────────────

  async getSavedReports(userId: number) {
    return this.savedRepository.find({ where: { userId }, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' }, take: MAX_SAVED });
  }

  async saveReport(userId: number, name: string, type: string, data: any) {
    const cleanName = String(name ?? '').trim();
    const cleanType = String(type ?? '').trim();
    if (!cleanName || cleanName.length > 160) throw new BadRequestException('Nom du rapport requis (160 caractères maximum).');
    if (!cleanType || cleanType.length > 40) throw new BadRequestException('Type de rapport requis.');
    if (data !== undefined && data !== null && JSON.stringify(data).length > MAX_BYTES) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Rapport trop volumineux pour être enregistré : réduisez la période ou exportez-le en fichier.');
    }
    if ((await this.savedRepository.count({ where: { userId } })) >= MAX_SAVED) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Vous avez déjà ${MAX_SAVED} rapports enregistrés : supprimez-en avant d’en ajouter.`);
    }
    const report = await this.savedRepository.save(this.savedRepository.create({ userId, name: cleanName, type: cleanType, data: data ?? null }));
    return { success: true, message: 'Rapport sauvegardé', report };
  }

  async deleteSavedReport(id: number, userId: number) {
    const res = await this.savedRepository.delete({ id, userId });
    if (!res.affected) throw new NotFoundException('Rapport non trouvé');
    return { success: true, message: 'Rapport supprimé' };
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Delete, Body, Param, Query, UseGuards, Request, ParseIntPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { PermissionsService } from '../auth/permissions.service';
import { ReportsService } from './reports.service';

import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
@ApiTags('Rapports')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('reports')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class ReportsController {
  constructor(private readonly reportsService: ReportsService, private readonly permissions: PermissionsService) {}

  @Get('sales')
  async getSalesReport(@Request() req: any, @Query('start') start?: string, @Query('end') end?: string) {
    return this.reportsService.getSalesReport(req.user.userId, start, end);
  }

  @Get('inventory')
  async getInventoryReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getInventoryReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('clients')
  async getClientsReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getClientsReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('employees')
  async getEmployeesReport(@Request() req: any) {
    // Le droit « rapports » ne donne pas accès aux salaires : il faut aussi le droit RH (le propriétaire l'a toujours).
    const { role, permissions, isTeamMember } = req.user;
    const withSalaries = this.permissions.can(role, permissions, 'hr:view', !!isTeamMember);
    return this.reportsService.getEmployeesReport(req.user.userId, withSalaries);
  }

  @Get('logistics')
  async getLogisticsReport(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getLogisticsReport(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get('saved')
  async getSavedReports(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.getSavedReports(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Post('saved')
  async saveReport(@Request() req: any, @Body() body: { name: string; type: string; data: any }) {
    return this.reportsService.saveReport(req.user.userId, body?.name, body?.type, body?.data);
  }

  @Delete('saved/:id')
  async deleteSavedReport(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Request() req: any) {
    return this.reportsService.deleteSavedReport(id, req.user.userId);
  }
}

---
name: blog-ne-pas-modifier
description: "Inovexa ERP : ne pas modifier le blog (articles et pages /blog) sans demande explicite"
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Le 2026-11-25, en confiant la transformation SaaS complète du site et de l'ERP, l'utilisateur a précisé :
« vous ne change pas blogs ».

Concerne `frontend/content/site/posts/**` et `frontend/app/(site)/blog/**` (articles, index, pages de blog).

**Why:** non expliqué par l'utilisateur. Mon interprétation : le contenu du blog est considéré comme terminé
(nombreux articles SEO en 3 langues) et il ne veut pas qu'une refonte y touche par ricochet.

**How to apply:** lors d'un travail sur le site public (en-tête, pied de page, tarifs, produits, accueil),
laisser ces fichiers strictement identiques ; le rappeler dans le brief de tout sous-agent ; vérifier à la fin
avec `git status` qu'aucun fichier du blog n'apparaît. Ne lever cette règle que si l'utilisateur demande
lui-même une modification du blog.

Voir aussi [[user-ecrit-francais-derja]].

---
name: postgres-local-bases-jetables
description: "Inovexa ERP : PostgreSQL local disponible pour créer des bases jetables (tests e2e, vérification de migration)"
metadata:
  type: reference
---

Sur le poste de l'utilisateur (Windows), PostgreSQL 18 tourne sur `localhost:5432` ; `psql` est dans le PATH de Git Bash.
Les identifiants locaux sont dans `backend/.env` sous d'anciens noms (`DB_HOST`, `DB_PORT`, `DB_USERNAME`, `DB_PASSWORD`,
`DB_DATABASE`) — l'application, elle, ne lit que `DATABASE_URL` et ne charge pas ce fichier. Le compte est superutilisateur :
il peut créer et supprimer des bases.

Usage constaté le 2026-11-25 :
- tests de bout en bout : `E2E_ADMIN_URL=postgres://…/postgres npm run test:e2e` (dans `backend/`) crée puis supprime la base `erp_e2e` ;
- vérification d'une migration : créer une base temporaire, `npm run migration:run`, puis `npm run migration:generate -- CiCheck`
  doit répondre « déjà à jour » (si un fichier `*-CiCheck.ts` est écrit, le supprimer).

La base locale `inovexa_erp` est un ancien schéma d'avant les migrations (24 tables, pas de table `schema_migrations`) :
ne pas la modifier ; pour tester une montée de version, la copier avec `pg_dump | psql` dans une base jetable.

Ne jamais afficher le mot de passe : le lire depuis le fichier dans un script et construire l'URL sans l'imprimer.

Dans ce terminal, un script Python passé en « heredoc » échoue parfois selon son contenu (apostrophes, barres obliques inverses) :
écrire le script dans un fichier avec l'outil d'écriture, puis l'exécuter.

automatique n'a eu lieu (des fichiers modifiés sont restés non committés longtemps). Ce n'est donc pas un script :
ce sont des commits faits à la main par l'utilisateur, quand il travaille sur main.

**Why:** un travail à moitié fait sur main se retrouve publié (et sans doute déployé : frontend hébergé, API sur Render)
avant d'être terminé ou vérifié.

**How to apply:** pour une modification en plusieurs étapes, travailler sur une branche dédiée (et le dire) plutôt que sur
main ; sinon garder l'application utilisable à chaque étape et n'activer la partie visible qu'à la fin. Ne jamais écrire
dans le dépôt de fichiers sensibles (rapport de failles, secrets) : les mettre hors du dépôt. Ne pas pousser sur main
sans accord explicite de l'utilisateur.

Voir aussi [[user-ecrit-francais-derja]], [[blog-ne-pas-modifier]].

Terminé et testé — API

Inscription libre, connexion Google (vérifiée côté serveur), confirmation d'email, essai gratuit de 72 h calculé par le serveur, états du compte (essai, actif, expiré, suspendu, résilié), formules, paiements déclarés puis validés par l'administrateur, 10 secteurs avec leurs modules, tableau de bord administrateur sur données réelles.
Failles d'isolation entre sociétés corrigées (11 tables concernées, profil, routes ouvertes sans connexion, transporteurs).
481 vérifications de bout en bout passées avant mes derniers ajouts ; une nouvelle passe tourne en ce moment sur les rapports enregistrés et les anciens indicateurs codés en dur que je viens de remplacer par de vrais calculs.
En cours — interface

Neuf agents construisent en parallèle : inscription et connexion, abonnement et bandeau d'essai, logistique en trois pages (une par ancien onglet, comme demandé), suggestions par secteur, espace administrateur (comptes, paiements, formules, secteurs, réglages, journal), pages Tarifs et Produits, accueil.
Ensuite : compilation complète, test des pages, puis documentation et paquet de déploiement Namecheap.
Ce qui est fait de votre côté pour l'instant : rien. Tout est sur la branche claude/saas-platform, en local ; rien n'est poussé ni déployé, et le blog n'est pas touché.

الجواب: ليس الآن. الواجهة ما زالت قيد الكتابة ولم تُجمَّع بعد، فلا توجد حزمة جاهزة للرفع. لو رفعتَ الآن سيتعطّل الموقع. موقعك الحالي يواصل العمل كما هو في الأثناء.

عندما يجهز كل شيء، الترتيب يكون هكذا:

نسخة احتياطية من قاعدة البيانات قبل أي شيء.
الخادم أولًا على Render، لأن الواجهة الجديدة تحتاج المسارات الجديدة. عند تشغيله تُضاف الجداول الجديدة تلقائيًا دون حذف أي بيانات. يجب التأكد من وجود المتغيّرين JWT_SECRET وFRONTEND_URL هناك.
تجميع الواجهة على حاسوبك بعنوان الخادم الحقيقي (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)، لأن هذا العنوان يُثبَّت وقت التجميع.
إنشاء الحزمة بأمر واحد أُجهّزه لك (npm run package:namecheap)، ثم ضغطها في ملف zip.
في cPanel:
File Manager: ارفع ملف zip إلى مجلد التطبيق ثم فكّ الضغط.
Setup Node.js App: اختر Node.js 24، حدّد مجلد التطبيق، ملف التشغيل server.js، ثم اضغط Restart.
التجربة: افتح الموقع، سجّل دخولك كمسؤول، وجرّب تسجيل شركة جديدة.
ما أجهّزه لك: دليل مكتوب خطوة بخطوة (docs/DEPLOIEMENT-NAMECHEAP.md) مع أمر إنشاء الحزمة، وسأجرّب الحزمة على حاسوبك قبل تسليمها. الجزء الخاص بـ Passenger على Namecheap لا أستطيع تجربته من هنا، وسأشير إليه بوضوح في الدليل.

تنبيهان:

لا أستطيع الدخول إلى cPanel؛ الرفع ستقوم به أنت باتباع الدليل.
لن أرفع شيئًا إلى الفرع الرئيسي main ولن أنشر شيئًا دون موافقتك الصريحة.

Ouvrir Setup Node.js App, choisir Node.js 24, mettre server.js comme fichier de démarrage.
Cliquer Restart, puis ouvrir ton site pour vérifier.
Avant ça, il faudra mettre à jour le serveur sur Render en premier. Je te guiderai aussi pour cette étape.

Dis-moi quelle partie n'est pas claire et je la reprends.

توّا: ما تحطّ شي في cPanel.
الخدمة مازالت ما كملتش. مازال ما فمّاش ملف باش تبعثو. الموقع متاعك يخدم عادي، ما تمسّ شي.

كي نكمّل، نعطيك زوز حاجات:

ملف zip حاضر.
دليل فيه الخطوات، وحدة بوحدة.
وقتها تعمل 3 حاجات:

في cPanel افتح File Manager، ابعث ملف zip، وانزل على Extract.
افتح Setup Node.js App، اختار Node.js 24، وحطّ server.js كملف التشغيل.
انزل على Restart، وافتح الموقع متاعك باش تتأكد.
قبل هذا لازم نحدّثو السيرفر في Render الأول. نعاونك فيها زادة.

قلّي شنوّة الي موش واضح ونعاودهولك.

لا، ما تفسّخش توّا.

توّا الملف الجديد مازال موش حاضر. كان تفسّخ، الموقع يطيح وما عندك شي تحطّو في بلاصتو.
وحتى نهار الي نبدّلو، ما تفسّخش: بدّل اسم الدوسي القديم برك (مثلا site_old). هكّا كان صار مشكل، ترجّعو في دقيقة.
أنا ما نراش شنوّة فمّا في cPanel متاعك. ما تمسّش الحاجات الأخرى: الإيمايلات، قاعدة البيانات، ملف .htaccess، وأي دوسي ما تعرفش شنوّة هو.
الترتيب الصحيح وقتها:

بدّل اسم الدوسي القديم (ما تفسّخوش).
حطّ الملف الجديد واعمل Extract.
انزل على Restart وجرّب الموقع.
كان كل شي يخدم مليح بعد أيامات، وقتها تنجّم تفسّخ القديم.
استنّى حتى نقلّك "حاضر".
